tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1 na 1)༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar 'od brgya pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(1 ba 2)rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku gcig tu bsdus pa 'gro ba'i bla ma chen po ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la dus dang rnam pa kun tu mi phyed pa'i dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// ngag gi mchog sbyin mkhyen dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ chos rnams yongs kyi gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ rgyal ba snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ spro mdzad thog ma'i mgon po de la 'dud/ chags pa gtan bcom 'gro la kun tu chags pa sna tshogs sprul pa ston par mdzad pa'i sku/ spros pa nyer zhi rtogs par bya slad spros pa sna tshogs chos kyi sgo rnams brjod pa'i gsung*/ shes bya thams cad ma 'dres 'byed kyang shes bya sna tshogs bde chen gcig pur sdud pa'i thugs/ yon tan mtha' rnams brjod brtson rnams kyis yon tan sna tshogs nam yang rtogs min mgon de rgyal/ gna' sngon bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang nas grong khyer grong ral dag dang rgyal srid 'byor pa rin chen nor bu gos bzang rlung mgyogs shugs ldan rta dang glang po shing rta chung ma bu sdug dang*/ rang gi mgo dang mig lag rkang pa sha bcad gtang bar dka' ba ba kun sbyin tshul khrims rnam dag 'bri yi rnga ma ci 'dra de 'drar bsrungs shing 'gro ba'i mi phan sna tshogs bzod byas rim gror bgyis/ yon tan rnam mang ye shes sgrub la brtson 'grus shin tu brtan zhing mi g.yo yul la dga' ba rgod cing 'phro ba'i sems gtul bsam gtan la dgyes rgya chen shes pa'i rab kyis pha mthar phyin gyur (2 na 3)pa/ de lta mod kyi byang chub zhi ba'i go 'phang thob nas sdug bsngal rgya mtshor chud pa'i sems can theg gsum gdams pas yongs su sgrol ba'i bla ma la ni rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma dri ma med pa rgyas pa'i snying po dang ni ston zla nya ba lta bu'i zhal/ ut+pal dar ba'i 'dab me ltar yangs bai ḍūr+ya yi mchod sdong bzhin du mdzes pa'i spyan/

mar gyi sbyin sreg bgyis pa'i 'od 'phro bzhus sbyangs 'dzam klung gser gyi ri 'dra gzi brjid mda'/ dpal ldan grags pa bgrang yas kun gyis mchod pa ngag gi dbang po lce brgya sa bsngags par 'os/ gang yang snying rje'i tsha zer can/ smon lam rlung gis 'gro ba na/ ji snyed 'gro ba'i yid mtsho la/ 'char ba'i pha mtha' su yis shes/ de lta mod kyi dad pa'i glegs bu la/ grags pa nyi ma'i ri mo blta na sdug /dag snyan lha yi tshon bkra brlan byas pa'i/ kun rtog pir gyis legs par bri bar bya/ mnyan pa'i rna ba blta ba'i mig /don sems yid dang klog pa'i lce/ kun dga' rab skyed bdud rtsi 'di/ bdag gi blo gros dge bas sbyin/ bskal pa grangs med pa mang por dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs shing sems can tshad med grangs med pa mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam du btsud par mdzad/ bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad shin tu tshar bcad nas yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa chen po la bzhugs pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che mchog dam pa thogs pa med par bskor ba 'khor lo bsgyu ba'i brgyud du byung ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba chen po thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku mi g.yo la/ rnam par rtog pa med par thugs rje chen po dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang dam pas/ 'gro ba'i rgyud dag pa'i sa gzhi ji snyed pa (2 ba 4)la de snyed pa'i skur 'char ba/ de nyid sman pa thams cad kyi byed pa por gyur to/ de yang*/ 'dir bdag cag gi skal ba ji tsam pa de tsam pa'i yon tan gyi phung po/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa sku'i bdag nyid/ dpal ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na rab tu bsgreng ba de'i rnam par thar pa'i rol pa rmad du byung ba 'di lta ste/ sngon byung ba'i dus na/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi grong khyer ga la bar mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka zhes grags pas rdzu 'phrul gyis skye bo mang po'i 'khor ba bsnyil nas/

de las kha phyir phyogs par mdzad pa gang dang*/ kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bus/ dri ma med pa'i 'od dkar can gyi zhabs sen la reg par byas shing btud pa'i/ lo tsa ba chen po mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhes bya rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' gzigs shing*/ mchog gi de nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pas/ dbang rnon nges pa dang bral ba'i tshogs lus gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa po dang*/ grub pa'i ring lugs 'dzam bu'i gling na 'gran zla med par 'dzin pa'i dbang po/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rin po che thams cad kyis gang ba'i rgya mtsho/ dbon ras dar ma seng ge zhes lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gcig pu pa dang*/ gna' dus kyi skye bo dag dga' ba bskyed pa'i zlos gar gyi rtsed 'jo ci yang mdzad do zhes 'jig rten na mngon par grags shing skye bos shes pa nyid do// de ltar/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i dpal rgyas shing 'byor pa bde ba dang legs shing nyams dgyes pa skye bo mang pos gang ba la/ gser sa le sbram gyi kha dog ltar kun tu bzang po'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rtsibs stong dang mu khyud lte ba dang bcas pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che chos kyis bskor ba la thogs pa med pa/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas (3 na 5)dbang bskur ba thob pa'i chos kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes rabs nas rabs su byon pa dag kyang*/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po can/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par sprul pa sha stag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ yun ring po nas sems can thams cad la phan par zhugs pa/ byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i yon tan thams cad dang rtag tu 'dris pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon dang*/ skyabs dang*/ skyob pa dpung gnyen bla na med pa 'ba' zhig go// de yang*/

mkhas pa dang grub par grags pa'i sgras rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po'ang 'dar bar byas shing*/ phas rgol glang po'i tshogs kyi klad pa 'gems pa/ smra ba'i seng ge kun dga' dpal 'byor lha dang bcas pa'i srid pa na rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes 'gran zla med pa'i dpa' bo gcig pu bar gyur pa de nyid gdan rabs bcu bzhi pa yin la/ gang gi gcung mtho ris kyi yon tan du mas brjid pa'i nang so lha'i dbang po pa ni srid skyong ba por gyur to/ dus nam zhig gi tshe yar 'brog khyung po do pa'i sras mo/ bsod nams chen po'i gzi rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pas/ lha'i na chung thig le'i mchog ma la 'gran par bzod pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ tshul du shis pa/ blta na dug pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ lang tsho rgyas pa zla ba'i me long gsar pa smra shes pa lta bu byang sems nam mkha' 'jom zhes pa/ bros stabs kyis ra lung du phebs pa yang*/ re zhig gsang ba ltar bzhugs te/ gdung gcig gnyis 'khrungs pa gzhan du gyur pa'i dbang gis sras 'dod pa'i gdung bas mchod sbyin sna tshogs pa'i thabs la zhugs so// der/ sngon sangs rgyas dbon ras pas/ mchod rten chen mo'i rab tu gnas pa'i skabs/ ma 'ongs pa na 'di la zhig gsos dgos pa'i dus zhig 'ong*/ de dus kho bo rang bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong la sleb dgos par 'dug gsung ba'i zhal gyis 'ches par bya ba dus tshod la bab pa/ snying rje chen pos 'jig rten kun tu gzigs te/ nyi sgrol (3 ba 6)byed kyi lo/ sa ga zla ba'i dkar po'i cha rnam par 'phel ba'i bzang po gsum pa'i tho rangs rnga brdung ba tsam gyi tshod la/ bod yul gyi lte ba/ dbus gtsang gnyis kyi con pan/ rtse mo shin tu mtho ba'i shel gyi lhun po dang kha dog bzang po rin po che sna tshogs pa'i ri bos/ khor mo yug ngu bskor ba/ gang gi lte ba dang bcas pa'i sa phyogs lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing*/ ka tsa lin+da ltar reg na bde ba/

shin tu bzang ba/ yangs pa 'dab ma brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa lta bu'i legs la bkra shis pa'i rtags rnams legs par bkod pa/ rtsa sngon po rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bus khebs pa/ rtsa ba dang*/ sdong bu dang*/ me tog bzang pos brgyan pa/ sgro gshog mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i bya'i tshogs dang*/ ri dwags gzhon nu blta na sdug pa rtsed 'jol mkhas pas yongs su gtams pa/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ni yul gzhan dor nas 'di na 'dus pa bzhin/ 'jig rten gzhan du bsod nams byas pa lhan cig tu skyes pa 'dra ba legs par byas pa thams cad kyis legs par byas pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu/ me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs/ dpal ra lung thel gyi ri bo chen po gru 'dzin gyi dogs/ spos skya chos kyi pho brang du dge legs bye ba'i rtags dang bcas te lhums su zhugs so// de nas gzung yum nyid ni ting nge 'dzin gyi 'tsho ba bzang pos lus sems brtas la/ yul phyogs rnams sum rtsen gyi grong khyer sa la 'phos pa bzhin du mngon par mtho ba'i dpal zad mi shes pa la spyod par gyur to/ der rje'i zhal snga nas/ ma 'di'i lus la yod pa 'di bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa'i skyes bu chen po zhig 'ong nges pas/ brag 'jam dbyangs ye shes rin chen gyis mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i grub pa brnyes pa'i gnas yin pas 'di nyid du mtshams dam par chod la bka' srung kyi gsol mchod la brtson par gyes zhes zhal bkod dang*/ dpal ye shes (4 na 7)mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang bka' bsgo stsal/ bka' srung kyi rtag gtor bzhengs/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis sku'i srung ba por bskos/ der kyang mi 'gyed par sleb yong gsung ba'i bka' gnang ste rje nyid lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri trar byon te/ de yang rin po che'i mchod sdong bzhin du dbus gtsang lho byang gi dbung na 'phyur bur gsal ba grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi pho brang gdan sa rin po che ra lung gi cha ba 'og brag kha chos dbyings rdo rje gdan du/

sa skyong gi lo bcom ldan 'das shākya'i tog gis cho 'phrul chen pos seng ge rnam par rtse ba bstan pa'i dus chen gyi dngos gzhi chos brgyad la nyin byed dbang po snang ba chen po'i dga' ston 'gyed par 'ongs pa shar ri'i rtser son pa dad dus mnyam par/ dpal dang gzi brjid kyis 'bar ba 'jig rten na mthu dang dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyang mog mog por byed pa de btsas so// de ma thag tu/ snying stobs kyi phung po chen po 'di 'dra ba'i khur gang gis bzod par mi nus so snyam du rgya mtsho'i gos can skrag pa bzhin du 'dar zhing g.yo bar gyur la/ sprin dbang po'i mtshon chas brgyan pa dag skabs gsum pa'i rin po che'i gdugs bzang po ltar mdzes pas kun tu 'khrigs shing*/ mā la ya'i rlung gis ha ri tsan dan gyi nags bskyod pa lta bu'i rlung 'jam po reg na bde ba dri zhim pa dag kyang ldang*/ lha'i me tog gi char bzang po dal bu dal bur 'bab po zhes skye bo sngon gyi tshul dran pa dag sgrog go// de nas rgya grags bon po rgyal mtshan pa la sri'u bcol nas/ ring por ma lon pa zhig na kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po phebs te/ bka' rjes gnang mang dag gnang*/ yum gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams legs par bsgrubs so// de dus rje'i sku pang du bzhes shing mnyes mnyes mang du mdzad nas gces spras su gyis shig gsungs te/ dpon slob kun slar bod yul shar phyogs pa rnams kyi mos pa'i shing rta chen por thegs so// de ni gang 'khrungs pa'i phyi lo (4 ba 8)yin no// de nas rgya grags thang sper lo gsum tsam sri bros kyi tshul du bzhugs so// de'i dus lho'i bla ma dbu che mang dag 'dus nas dga' ston chen po byas so// dus de dag tu rtsed 'jo'i rnam 'gyur la'ang skyes bu dam pa ci bya ba bsngags par 'os pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba ni cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing*/

na tshod kyi khur lci ba dag kyang gnas de las bzlog par byed de/ skabs de nyid du bla ma kun dga' bkra shis kyis yi ge klog pa'i tshul phul kyang*/ dag pa dang rus thon pa'i chen du skom sde 'gro mgon bla brang par gtsug lag gi gzhi ma 'dri ba dang klog pa dpyis phyin pa slob par mdzad pa'i skabs/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyal ba'i bka' sgrogs pa na/ thag ring mo na gnas pa'i skye dgu rnams kyis thos pas rab tu chags shing yid stor ba ltar gyur to/ dus de dag tu/ dam pa dang ngan pa lhan cig skyes kyang skyes kyang yun ring mo nas legs pa dang nyes pa'i spyod pas goms pa'i ngang tshul ma mtshungs pas bkur sti ma yin pa du mar bgyis pa de dag gi bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba kho na yin te/ skyes bu chen po 'di la khro ba dang 'dzin pa mi mnga' bas/ de dag bzod cing byams pa chen pos rim gror byed pas so// dgung lo bcu gnyis pa gdong can gyi lo la/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po che bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshal dpal me rag mdor sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhing*/ tsa ri sgam po sogs dkar rgyud kyi bstan pa 'phel rgyas su mdzad de/ slar lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams zhabs kyis 'chag par mdzad nas gdan sa chen por phebs rgyu'i gtam gsan pas dgyes pa bla na med par gyur to/ de lta'i mdo la 'khor rgya chen po'i tshogs dang bcas te bsu ba la byon/ rje btsun mar pa'i gdan sa gro bo lung du phebs nas zangs phug tu bzhugs gnas mdzad do// der rje'i gsung 'phrin/ ded dpon slob de ring sleb kyi yod pas bsu ba la ma yong sang 'bod mi shra tong gsung ba phebs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sngon yun ring po nas bsten (5 na 9)pa ni byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba rnams kyis nam yang brjed par mi 'gyur ba chos nyid yin pas/ bla ma mjal bar rings te/ 'di snyam du thun tshod brgya dang ldan pa bzhin yongs su mi 'dzad pa'i mtshan mo 'dis bdag gi don chen po thob pa'i gegs byas so zhes yang yang du sems par mdzad cing gzigs so// de nas bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi thig le gsar pa dang*/

rgyu skar gyi do shal bzang po'i mdzes pa 'chang ba'i sngo bsangs ma yang nub phyogs pa'i sred ldan gyi rtse dga'i ched du song nas mi ring bar gdan 'dren pas sleb ste/ rings stabs kyis byon pa na cog pu bzhi dul gyis mdzes pa brgya phrag du mas ser sbreng dang bro mo che 'bul ba/ phyag dang bcas pa'i zhe sas mdun bsus te/ gtsug lag khang gi g.yas phyogs kyi spang khar bzhugs sgar 'dug sar phebs so// pad+ma can gyi dga' ba shar ba dang dus gcig dang*/ nyi ma brgya pas lhag pa'i gzi brjid rab tu gsal ba/ gdan seng ge'i khri la lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa mthong ngo*// de ma thag tu dad pa'i tsha zer gyis lag pa'i ku mu ta zum pa bzhin du byas te phyag 'tshal zhing zhabs mthil bkra shis pa'i tshon byugs pa spyi bor bkod pas nor bus mtshan pa'i con paṇa rnams skyengs par byas so// dar cig na zhabs phyir yod pa rnams la 'byon lam gyi dri rtsa da zhib par gnang skabs/ nyid kyi dgongs par/ nga yong ba la mnyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dug zer ba mi bden pa 'dra ci ltar yin snyam pa byung gsung*/ de nas bka' stsal phebs pa dang*/ sgar gyi logs su ma nam ma/ dwags po'i chos bzhi dang bcas pa'i bshad pa dang dogs pa zhib par gsungs nas/ deng phyin chad ma chag par gyis/ phebs pa ltar rnam kun tu zhal 'don du mdzad pa yin no// de nyin rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i dus chen gza' dang skar ma 'phred dang sbyor ba bzang po thams cad 'dzoms pas/ rje mar pa'i sku 'dra rin po che'i drung du gtsug phud 'breg pa gnang*/ mtshan ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal por gsol/ rgyal (5 ba 10)ba'i bstan pa sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin par gtad/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen dang*/ bar ma rab tu byung ba bsgrubs so// sems bskyed kyi cho ga chos rjes paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs las smon 'jug chabs gcig pa'i sdom pa bzhes pa na byang chub kyi sems rin po che lhag par 'phel bas 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa'i ma ltar du brtse ba mnga'o// mnga' bdag rgyal po mai tri pa'i bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa che ga mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing 'khrul pa med par nos pas/

rig 'dzin bla na med pa'i sngags sdom thob cing*/ de rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs/ bslab bya mdor bsdus/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa la sogs pa bslab pa'i gnas mtha' dag gi bshad pa gsan cing*/ lag len mthar thug pa bslab par mdzad pas blang dor 'byed pa la shin tu mkhas te/ nyes byas phra mos kyang ma gos so// de nas gzung bde mchog gi rgya bod kyi gzhung*/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i lugs phyag na rdo rje lha nyer lnga ma dang*/ lha lnga la sogs pa'i dbang byin rlabs/ rgya bod kyi sgrub thabs las sna tshogs pa/ sha ba ra'i lugs/ phag mo lhan cig skyes ma'i byin rlabs dang yig sna/ slob dpon dril bu zhabs kyi lugs/ dbang po rab kyi nyams len bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rgya bod kyi sgrub thabs kyi/ gzhung*/ dpal rdo rje srin po he ru ka phyag bzhi pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ mgon po klu sgrub yab sras la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mang dag dang*/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po mkhas shing grub pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i zhi ba rgyas pa dbang drag po'i bsnyen pa sgrub pa las sbyor gyi gzhung lag len yongs su rdzogs par gsan no// phyag chen ye shes 'khor lo la khring*/ dkar brgyud gser 'phreng rgya ba chos su gsan te/ rim gyis phebs skabs pad+ma gling nas grub la la thegs nyin/ 'phred rings der rje khu dbon gyi chibs kyi (6 na 11)thad kar ba bod chen po zhig rbab tu 'dril ba la/ rje'i drung gis gzigs stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa tsam gyis dum bu gsum du song ste/ gnyis mdun rgyab tu thal zhing*/ gcig sku mdun gong gi pha bong zhig gis brten no// de dag gi lo rgyus zhib pa rwa 'chad ma thub pa'i gnad cig byung gsung*/ de nas gad mdor phebs/ grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha gcig bum cig gi dbang dang*/

rje btsun chen po 'bar ra bas mdzad pa'i tshe khrid kyang gsan no// de nas stag ri ba'i gdan 'dren byung bas phebs/ bzhugs ring dpon slob mang dag gis phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid du skyong bar mdzad/ phyag chen skor gsum cha lag tshang ba lung du gsan/ de nas chos rdzong du phebs/ gtsug lag khang du mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsa dang rmog rin po che bdun brgyud kyi phyag bzhes gtsang ma'i dgyes rdor lha dgu'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par gsan cing*/ sgrub dkyil lag len rnam bshad dang bcas pa'ang gnang ngo*// de nas dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud thugs la 'dzin pa dang*/ 'grel pa rin po che'i rgyan 'dra ba'i steng nas bshad pa tshig don dpyis phyin par gnang ba gnyis ka mi ring bar rdzogs par mdzad do// bzhi chos gzhung 'grel rje dwags po'i rnal 'byor lam rim/ la yag byang chub dngos grub kyi chos bzhi rtsa 'grel/ rje btsun gling gi sgron me rnam drug dang bcas pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma/ 'gro mgon gyi bka' 'bum/ chos rje na rim gyi gsung ngag khrigs su bkod pa rnams gsan no// de'i tshe sangs rgyas dbon gyi dus na yod la/ rjes thogs kyi skye bos mi mngon pa'i khron pa zhig gzhon nu gang gis 'khor kha yar dang bcas lcags ri'i zur khugs der phebs nas skye dgus shes par mdzad pa na/ thams cad du sangs rgyas dbon gyi rnam par sprul pa nyid do zhes grags so// de nas ri nag dang*/ rtse thur sogs nas dge'u gangs su phebs/ rje'i gsung gi rten 'brel (6 ba 12)gyi sgo chen po zhig yod pas/ gnas 'di nyid du dbon gyi spyil po la dmigs pa zhig cog pu ba rnams kyis rtsigs shig /grub rjes zhag gsum gyi bar de nyid du 'dug gnas kyis zhes dang*/ gos chen gyi dbu sgom shin tu legs pa cig gnang ngo*// skabs de dag tu chos kyi gsan pa ni nam langs nas sa rub kyi bar du'o// de nas gdan sa chen po me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs ra lung thel du phebs te/

ra lung pa rnams kyis bsu ba'i rim pa dang bcas nas nā ro pa'i phyi rten bkra shis sgo mangs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin che bar 'jig rten na grags pa de'i mdun gyi spang khar sgar mdzad do// de dus phyogs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen lung rigs kyi sbyangs pa chen po mang du tshogs te/ chos kyi 'bel ba'i gtam gyi bgro gleng*/ dad 'dus kyi nya ma'i khrom la chos gnang bas khor mo yug tu 'da' ba/ de'i tshe gangs can gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la gnod par byed pa'i mi ma yin chen po zhig gzhon nu gang la bar du gcod pa'i ched du/ re zhig rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can du brdzus te/ phyogs der gnas nas glags ma rnyed par ring zhig thal ba de yang*/ rje'i byin rlabs gzi 'od kyis 'jigs shing*/ dam pa'i chos kyi bgro bas ngo 'khums te/ bros pa phyogs gar song dang 'dir sleb bya ba skye bo sus kyang ma shes so// de nas ri bo chen po gru 'dzin gyi dogs 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs pa'i gan+dho la dpal spos skyar khu dbon lhan du gdan chags par mdzad do// de dus dbang rnon tshe gcig la sangs rgyas kyis rab kri ba'i gdams pa/ rje btsun dpal nā ro pa'i gsung ngag bsre 'pho'i khrid/ nyam nga med seng ge lta bu'i spyod pas bzang ngan gyi snang ba lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams pa ro snyoms skor drug /dam pa'i chos rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rabs bdun gyi khrid lung*/ lam rba bla ma sgrub pa 'gro ba'i mgon po yab sras kyi khyad chos khrid chen po brgyad/ (7 na 13)slob dpon dpe med 'tsho dang sha ba ra'i lugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen la gsan pa'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'am/ rdo rje bzhi'i bsnyen sgrub gsar ma/ grub thob chen po o ḍi ya ṇā ba rin chen dpal gyis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dbang mor thos pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dang*/

'phreng bskor/ brda rtsa la sogs pa zhogs chos snga chos dgongs chos mtshan mo zla ba yod pa'am/ med dus sgron me la 'bel gtam/ rnam par bshad pa thugs rtsom la sogs pa 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bas 'khor mo nyid 'das pa'i dus de dag tu ngang tshul bzang zhing dul ba thos bsam la 'grus pa'i skye bo'i yid 'phrogs so// rje'i gsung nas/ nged tsa ri sgam po phyogs la bsdad na tshe ring bar yod pas myur du 'gro ba yin zhes mang du phebs rung*/ phyogs gang du gnas pa rnams kyis nan chags pa'i zhu ba la brten/ mi bzhugs ka med par gyur pa nas/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga la sku khams cung zad mnyel ba sku 'brum yin par nges te/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu 'os pa gang*/ dus de phan sku dang grib ma bzhin du ming bral bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par mdzad mod/ skabs der bzad pa'i zhal ngo dbon po rnam par grol ba'i sde zhes pa blo gros phun sum tshogs pa de dang*/ gzims dpon a'o dkon mchog mdzes gnyis kyis gtso sar/ phyag g.yog tu gnyer ba mdzad de/ mar khu'i gzhong pa gang zhes par bzhugs so// snga dgongs thugs sbyong khrigs chags dang*/ dgung seng la spos skya gzigs sar phyag 'bul dang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs du mar mdzad do// de nas smin drug can gyi dmar po'i cha yi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i srod kyi dus la bab pa'i tshe/ dpon slob kun thugs bshar grub rjes/ gzims mal du phebs ma thag 'od zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu phyi nang gi gnas kun gsal ba'i rtags dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pas dus (7 ba 14)'das so// der gnas nang pa rnams kyis spos skya gzims khang nas 'od kyi phung po rdzam tsam zhig shar phyogs ra la'i stongs su thal song ba kun mthun grub tu gleng ngo*// de yang mchog gi sprul pa bya'i rigs kyi rgyal por phebs pa'i snga rtags su nges so// de nas zla ba tsam gyi bar gsang thabs kyi ngang nas mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bkur sti phul du byung ba bgyis so// zla mchod kyi stengs su dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi bsgrub pa'i skabs/

dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dbur rgyal sras gzhon nu nyid phebs par mdzad pas rgyu skar gyi khrod na zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar mdzes pa mthong bas skye dgu rnams kyi mya ngan bsangs par gyur to/ de rjes bu slob rnams so sor bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong dang*/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan dben pa'i sbo mthon po rnams su 'dzugs pa la byon no// nyid klog pa'i slob dpon du dge slong bsod nams mchog ldan pa bsten te/ sbyangs pa 'phro ma dang rje'i gsung zin thun du skyor bar mdzad cing*/ rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub chen shākya 'phel bar rje spos skya pa'i phyag chen gyi khrid yig steng nas nyams khrid du zla ba gsum skyong bar mdzad pa dang ro snyoms khrid dang khrigs ma/ zhal gdams nges pa can rnams gsan cing*/ gsang ba'i spyod pa mang du mdzad do// de nas mi 'khrugs pa lha so bdun gyi dbang dang*/ 'brug skor gyi khrid gdams pa phal che ba dag kyang gsan no// 'gro mgon blo mchog grags par sgrub dkyil lnga'i phyag len bslabs shing*/ grub chen dpal bzang ba dang*/ drung don rin par nyer mkho re yang gsan no// dgung lo bcu bzhi lon pa gnan/ 'phyang gi lo la rje'i nang rten rnams grub nas/ bu chen phal cher 'dus/ rgyal ba'i myu gu gang dkar brgyud rin po che yab sras kyis rim par bzhugs pa'i gdan seng ge'i khrir chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bar mnga' gsol te dga' ston rgya chen po yang byas (8 na 15)so/ de yang*/ pad+ma'i rdzing bur ngang pa'i rgyal po bya phran gyis bskor ba ltar/ bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi mgon du mdzes pa de nyid/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la/ bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi khur chen po khyer ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos skyabs dpal bzang po dang*/ phyag chen shes rab bzang pos gtsos pa ri pa dpon slob dang*/ 'dus pa mang po la/ 'brug skor lnga'i dpang rjes gnang*/

byin rlabs/ gsung ngag ro snyoms chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad do// kun ldan lcags pho byi lo la tsa ri trar rdzong dar mdzad de/ lho phyogs kyi gdul bya'i ched du phebs nas rim pas stag ri dang 'brog brgyud yar rgyab tu byon/ rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mched po thugs yid gnyis su med pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi tog dam pa skad gnyis smra ba chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sder/ lam dra be bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bka' 'brel rgyas pa zhig gsan no// de dus rje lo tsa ba'i gsung nas/ dbon rin po che da lan phebs pa shin tu legs/ rje 'brug pa rin po che nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu de gzhan don la gshegs rjes/ da sgos nged rang shul na mchis pa rnams kyis bstan pa la phan pa'i 'bungs gsum 'don dgos pas/ lo shas bzhugs pa'i thugs rtsis mdzod/ de ring sang bla ma g.yam spyil ba spyir thob rgya che zhing khyad par 'brug skor gyi cha la shin tu nges par yod pas/ der zhag bar bzhugs/ de nas nged kyi sar gdan 'dren gtong gsung ba phebs kyang*/ mi ring bar zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan no// de nas gra dga' ldan dang g.yam spyil du grub chen rin po che blo gros chos rgyal bar sgrub thabs skor lnga'i dbang rjes gnang*/ byin rlabs yig sna'i lung shin tu tshang ba dang*/ ras chung snyan rgyud kyi dbang khrid cha tshang*/ tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dbang*/ lam zab sogs 'brug skor/ 'bar ra ba'i chos skor/ gcod yul gyi rim pa mtha' dag /(8 ba 16)sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rnam rgyal ba'i sngags 'dul chen mo/ rgyal pa yang dgon zhabs kyi ri chos skor gsum sogs shin tu rgya che bar gsan no// de nas gdan sa chen po thel du phebs/ lhun sder bzhugs te/ dpal rdo rje brag sle bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzims khang du/

rgyal dbang rje'i bu chen/ mkhas grub chen po mkhan chen dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan pa'am/ lhun sde rab 'byams pa zhes grags pa la lugs kyi gsar ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub dkyil dang bcas pa kun mkhyen kha che nyid kyis mdzad pa/ man ngag gi mthar thug rim pa lnga'i dmar khrid/ dkar khrid nag khrid kyi skor shin tu tshang ba/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgrub dkyil gyi lung dril bu pas mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i khrid sogs dang*/ gshed dmar gyi dbang dang spros med kyi chos skor glo bo lo tsa bas mdzad pa/ bzhi chos sgra 'khor dang sha ba ri ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i rjes gnang*/ spyan snga nyer gnyis rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag chen lnga ldan dang sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ rje btsun mi la'i bka' 'bum ngan rdzong ston pas bsgrigs pa/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum dang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang rin po che brtson 'grus grags pa'i bka' 'bum dang bcas pa shin tu tshang bar gsan no// de nas chos 'khor chen po lha sar bstan pa'i gtso bo jo shāka rnam gnyis mjal smon lam rgya chen po dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs te/ gangs chen po 'brug tu re zhig stan chags nas/ dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog tu phebs so// der bag med pa'i sgo nas nyes par spyod pa sna tshogs pa la zhugs pa'i skye bo gzhan la sdang zhing bzod par dka' ba/ brkam zhing chags pa/ blun zhing (9 na 17)gti mug pa'i rang bzhin can 'ga' zhig thabs la mkhas pas 'dul bar dgongs te/ thugs las chung dus gzhol bar mdzad do// der mos pa'i rlung gis bgrod pas/ bstan pa'i nyin byed lho'i gdul bya pad+mo'i rtsa la gnyid du gyur to/

dus de'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po'i phyogs rnams/ bdud rtsi'i 'od dang bral ba'i ku mu ta bzhin du gyur pa na/ nongs pa can rnams kyang 'gyod pa chen pos sgrib pa bsrabs par gyur nas/ sbyin bdag sa skyong ba chen po rin chen spungs pa'i nad so mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*/ rgyal mkhar rtse ba'i nang so sog po 'phags pa zhes pa chos la mngon par gzhol ba gnyis kyis gdan 'dren gser yig dang*/ nyi bo gtsang phyogs pa'i bu slob gtos che ba sleb ste/ nan tan gyis gsol ba btab pas/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo byas pa drin du gzo bar mi byed la mgu bar shin tu dka' bas/ kho bo cag bya btang chos bzhin du bgyis pas thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba 'phel bar byed do// zhes gsungs pa na/ de dag dge ba'i tsha zer gyis/ sdig pa'i blo bzhu ba bzhin du mchi ma'i rgyun gyis gdong khebs shing g.yig pa sangs pa med pa dang*/ dbugs ring 'byin pa'i mthar pa rgyal bar gyur pa'i skabs der/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i sems can sngon yun ring po nas mgron du gnyer ba'i khams yongs su smin pa'i dus la bltas te/ snying rje chen pos zhal gyis bzhes nas dgung lo nyi shu ga khrom zhes pa shing po 'brug gi lo gdan sa rin po che dpal ra lung du phebs/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi skyon rnams shin tu rtogs shing shes pas 'jig rten gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad kyis sems la kun nas nyon mongs pa med par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas rjes su gnang*/ mkhas pas bstod/ mdzangs pas ma smad pa'i bgyi ba bzang pos thub pa'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad cing*/ 'gro ba rnams dga' ba bskyed par byas so// de'i phyi lo// gtsug lag khang chen mo yo (9 ba 18)'khyoms che bas rdig tu nye ba'i dus/ dbon po bsod nams dpal bzang gis sbyin pa'i bdag po byas nas/ steng thog bshu ba dang*/ khyams 'degs pa/

shing cha spo len rnams nyes pa med par tshang bar bsgrubs so// de nas zil gnon gyi lo/ mchod rten chen po bkra shis sgo mang*/ chos chen rim gyi thog gang la'ang nyes pa med par gyur kyang*/ skabs der nub byang gi phyogs gnyis ka zhig ste/ slar gso ba la zhugs pa'i tshe/ dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal bsogs chos ldan gyi bu chen mang pos srid pa'i sdug bsngal khyad du gsod pa'i las 'khur drag pos bka' ba dang du blangs shing*/ mi ma yin rnams kyis mtshan thog thag tu bya ba brtsams pas mis bsgrubs pa las rjes chos dod pa byung ngo*// dus der tshogs chen pos gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la/ sgyid lug pa nam gzhar yang mi mnga' bas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad phan pa dang bde bar mdzad pa la/ rang gi lus dang srog la mi blta ba 'di ni bdag cag gi mnyes gshin bzang po dang*/ bla ma'o zhes gleng la/ dga' ba las kyang chos dga' ba dang*/ mgu bas rim gror byed cing*/ sangs rgyas dbon nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa ji lta ba de ni mngon du gyur to/ de nas 'gro mgon bsod nams bzang po dang*/ phyag chen chos dbang gis mgo byas/ ri pa rnams la tsa ri trar 'gro chos gnang ba grol ston gyi nyi ma snga phyi bar du me tog gi char chen po lha'i tshogs kyis kun mthun grub tu phab bo// de dus yang dgon rgyal po'i pho brang la zhig gsos dgos pa'i ltas dang mtshan ma mang du byung ba'i mthus/ me mo lug gi lo la/ sa sel dang bcas pa rnams legs par bsgrubs/ de nas bla ma kun dga' bsam gtan pas/ mkhar chu ku ri byang chub snying po'i s+phor gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la gdan drangs/ de dus lho brag gzhung tal mar 'ja' 'od kyi lam sna 'dren pa dang*/ bya rgyal rgod po'i khyu chen pos mkha' la skyel bsu byed pa (10 na 19)khor mo nyid du byung bas/ kun yid mgu zhing*/ ngo mtshar gyis tshim par gyur to/

de nas tsa ri phyogs la thegs pa'i rtsis mdzad de lam la zhugs pa na/ bya rog mang pos lam 'gegs pa dang*/ mi snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ mthong na skyi zer byed pa rab tu mang pos slar ldog pa'i bskul ma mang du byas so// de dag la btang snyoms par byas pa na'ang*/ dpal ldan lha mo dus mtshan re ma tī skye bo'i lus la zhugs te smras pa/ ra lung du yang dgon gyang rar bcos nas thag ring la 'deg pa mi yong*/ de mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bsgor ba yin/ da zhig gsos rnams rdzogs par gyis/ nged rnams kyis kyang 'phrin las bsgrub pa yin zhes zer ba dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor rnams zhal gzigs so// dus de nas bzung lus dang grib ma bzhin skad cig kyang mi 'bral la/ legs nyes thams cad thag thogs med par lung ston cing*/ ci bsgo ba'i bkang la mnyan pas bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen por gyur to/ de nas bzo rigs mkhas pa mang po bgags te/ sngar gyang khang du 'dug pa/ rdo las grub pa zhig byung na zer gleng ngo*// der dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas rdo rab tu legs pa'i gter mang du 'thon te/ sa pho spre'u'i lo rags pa grub nas/ lho phyogs la 'byon pa'i phyir lam stag rir phebs so// skabs de nyid du bla ma kong po zer ba cha lugs brjod par dka' ba zhig mjal dgos zer ba/ nyi ma shar mtshams la mjal lo// mchid mo la/ a ma rdo rje phag mo'i lung bstan yin/ rgya nag la thogs/ rnga mo ga pa khal du khrid ces sogs bstan pa 'dzin skyong gi tshig 'ga' zhig las phal cher ma dgongs shing*/ de nas gar song gi mtha' ma nges par gyur to/ de rjes rim pas brag thog dgon pa'i mda' ku be ra phebs te khrom dbang mdzad rgyu'i mi dmangs ma 'dzom gong du rtogs ldan gangs (10 ba 20)kyi seng ge yin zer ba/ lo bdun cu tsam sha mdog dngas pa/

sma ra smin ma og zhol rnams dmar zhing dbyes phyed pa/ pad zhwa dang cha 'dra ba'i zhwa ngang pa'i mdog can cung zad brnyings pa zhig gyon pa/ rgyu ci yin sus kyang mi shes pa kha dog ngang cha'i sgro ltar mdzes pa'i gos dang zla gam gyon pa zhig byung ste/ nges med kyi mol mchid sna tshogs pa bgyid rjes/ ngas khyed kyi sar rten 'brel mang po bsgrig par yongs pa yin/ da nga 'gro yi zer nas song ngo*// der 'dus pa rnams la ri bran bzhin gnas gar yod kyi dri ba mdzad pa na/ mthong ba dang lo rgyus kyi rabs gang la'ang ma mchis so// de nas ra lung du phebs te/ spos skyar bzhugs dus/ phyogs 'dus kyi bskor ra ba mang du 'dzom pa'i tshe/ ban gzugs bya btang gi tshul la gnas pa mang po'i dkyil dang*/ gcig pu gang du 'dug rung*/ rnam pa kun tu mi g.yo ba gzugs tshad las ring zhing skad shin tu go dka' ba zhig kyang khams phyogs nas rje mjal ba ched du gnyer te yongs tshul phul bas/ spos skya gzims khang gi rtse po ta la ra mjal/ chos phyogs kyi gleng mo dang*/ bstan pa'i bya ba thor bu des pa tsam byung zhing*/ de yang gar song dang*/ 'di nas byung bya ba rtogs par ma gyur to/ de dag khyad tha mal pa ma yin zhing*/ gang 'dul gyi gzugs sku cir yang 'char ba yin pa'i nges pa rnyed pa zhig phyis byung yang*/ de'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa ma rtogs pa na so gzhon pa'i skyon tsam zhig byung gsung ngo*// dus der khyad 'phags mjal ka'i nyin khrom phyed tsam rdzogs dus/ nyams grib can gyi skye bo zhig gi mthus/ 'phags par sarba ṇa mi snang bar gyur/ zhag bdun gyi bar du gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pas snga mkho ltar phebs so// 'di lta bu'i mthu mnga' ba'i bla ma dang mjal bar skye ba mang por dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas pa zhig dgos so// de'i skabs lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyis skyong ba'i sras su rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku (11

na 21)'khrungs par kun mthun snang grub ste/ rgyun chags par cog pu ba brgyad brgya tsam gyis chos rgyal lhun po zhes pa pho brang gang nas phyogs bral gyi bstan pa skyong bar gsol ba 'debasapa yun ring du gnas so// de dus thog mar ja zhus la gsol dkar en bon chag med/ chibs gser gling du grags pas gtsos pa'i 'bul ba gtos che ba gnang ngo*// der bya ba nang sos gdan 'dren du dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal brdzong dar mdzad de/ ra lung du 'byor nas/ rje nyid dpon slob rags bsdus dang bcas pa 'brog brgyud/ gnyal yangs pa can zhes pa'i grong khyer gyi pho brang chen po chos rgyal lhun por mi dbang bkra shis dar rgyas legs pa'i rgyal po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dang thog mar mjal te/ dgyes spro'i dpal rgya chen pos sri zhur mdzad do// sprul pa'i sku gsal rje pad+ma dkar po na bzhugs pa spyan drangs nas gzims khang bkra shis brtsegs par mjal ba na gsung gis yid ches pa'i gnas kyang mang du stsal lo// tsha ba'i zer dang pad+mo bzang po'i tshal phrad pa ltar/ thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur cing*/ 'brug skor gyi rim pa zla gnyis/ tsam gyi bar 'gro tsa tsher mdzad do// de'i tshe sku tshe snga ma'i sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa las/ zhugs la phul na gang sar legs par 'dug ces mchod yon bka' bgros te/ rin thang can gyi dngos po gtos che ma'i 'bul ba mdzad do// de nas phyir phebs/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul mdzad pa na/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas chen po dang*/ spur khang zhal dbye ba'i tshe dbu thod rin po bai ḍū r+ya'i mdog lta bu ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pas tshom bur spras pa'i nang na lha sku'i rnam pa mang du yod pa/ thugs ljags sbrel ma ring bsrel gyis brgyan pa zhal klo spos shel gyi mdangs can ring bsrel gyi phra tshoms kyis 'brel ba/

gdung gas pa'i bsrubs nas 'phags kha sarba ṇa (11 ba 22)shin tu gsal ba dang ring bsrel gyi tshogs mang du byon no// de nas zha lu ri phug tu thegs te/ sku zhang chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po'i drung du rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ dpal mchog rdor sems 'jam dpal nam mkha' dri med/ 'jam dpal rigs bsdus nam mkha' dri med chung ba'i dbang rnams dang*/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang*/ thugs rje chen po pad+ma dra ba'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ rnam 'dzems ljang khu/ khro bo rma ba brtsegs pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug gtso 'khor gsum ma'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang dang smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga /bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang rig gtad/ thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i byin rlabs dang sgrub thabs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud nyung ngu dang*/ 'grel chen bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i steng nas slob bshad gtso bo dang*/ gzhan zhar byung*/ sngags btu dang bcas pa gsan no// bu ston zhabs kyi rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa nyams khrid du mdzad cing yongs rdzogs dang*/ grub thob chen po'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dang*/ sems nyid ngal bso'i skor/ theg chen blo sbyong don bdun ma rgyal sras rin po ches mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan ma gyen bsgreng*/ mtshan mo rgyu ba dang bcas pa mdor na bka' lung mang du gsan no// de nas gdan sa ra lung du gdan sa ra lung du gdan drangs te dpon slob thugs yid gnyis med du gyur lcags mo phag gi lo 'gro mgon dgon thung bas mgo byas ri thes rnams tsa ri trar bstan pa'i 'dzin skyongs la brdzangs so// rje nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i ring bsrel rnams bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i mchod sdong zhig sgrub par dgongs nas/

bya yul du byon/ gsal (12 na 23)rje pad+ma dkar por rgyal yum dbyangs can dga' mas zhabs tog zhus te re zhig bzhugs so// de nas sku skye rin po che yab sras dang chos rgyal gling du mjal ba mdzad de/ chos dbang gi rim pa thugs bzhed ji lta ba bzhin bskang ba mdzad do// de dus chos rgyal bya pas gser dngul srang grangs gtos che ba dang bcas pa'i 'bul bas 'od yangs kyi bu yang zhum par byas so// slar gtsang du phebs te/ rgyal rtse nas dpon rdo rje bas bzo'i rig byed bgyis nas bde chen man gser zangs las grub pa/ bang rim rnams gser zangs dngul ljang brdungs spel ma bum pa dang bre dngul rkyang 'ba' zhig pa/ rgyan dang tog la sogs pa blta na chog mi shes pa rin po che'i tshogs kyi phud por byas pa/ de'i bum nang du dngul sku dang bre'i logs la kha sarba ṇa rang byon/ dbu thod dang thugs ljags gser chab kyis sbran te na bzas phung por klubs gsangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung la sogs pa dang*/ gzungs kyi rim pa ni 'khrul pa med par bshad pa nyid bzhin du bzhugs so// chu pho byi ba'i lo la rab tu gnas pa dga' ston dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs dus mig mi 'dzum pa'i tshogs dag gis mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis mchod par byas so// gsung rten gsang sngags rgyud 'bum du ston rin po che'i dkar chag dang mthun par gser dngul spel ma las grub pa po ti bco brgyad bzhengs par mdzad do// de nas lho brag mkhar chu de wi ko ṭi byang chub snying po'i spor/ zla ba gsum sbrel tsam gyi bar sku mtshams shin tu dam par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gzhon nu 'jigs su dngar ba mi bsrun pa'i mdog can sha'i ral dmar gzings pa/ rgyu ma dang mi mgo'i ga sha 'phyang ba mang pos/ phyag zhabs nas bzung ste/ rgyab tu khur nas khang pa la thogs pa med par phyogs kun tu khyer song ba'i tshe bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag pas/

ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus bskyod ma nus te sngar mal du chud do// yang lan cig zil chen po yang nas yang du byung ba dang (12 ba 24)der bsam gtan la rtse gcig tu mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa na/ khang pa zhig pa dang thog rdib pa'i rnam pa chag tshom dang bcas pas sku lus spring cing thib kyis non pa lta bu dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las sad la/ bad pa tsam pa byung nas de yun ring lon pa dang jo yang du song ste srongs pa 'dra ba tshag chom gyi sgra chen po dang bcas te sangs kyes song ba sogs/ mngon sum nyams snang rmang lam du nyams sad pa'i mtho 'tsham pa sna tshogs pa byas so// de dag dge bsnyen chen po snyong kha la sogs phyogs der gnas pa'i mi ma yin rnams kyi cho 'phrul te thams cad kyang phyag rgya chen po'i zil 'og tu bcug nas/ bka'i 'bangs bgyid par rtsis la phab bo// sku mtshams grol rjes bya yul sa'i thig ler zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod nas rim pas 'on tshong 'dus brag khar/ rgyal ba kun gyi gong mu stag lung thang pa chen po dag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po phebs pa mjal nas chos 'brel gsan no// chos 'khor zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ sna phu gzigs te/ ston tshun 'brug tu bzhugs so// de yang dam pa'i chos yongs su 'tshol ba la brtson 'grus ltag par gyur cing thos bsam la ngoms pa med pas/ na lan+dhar sku zhang rin po cher sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang dang lung gsan nas/ dkar brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal stag lung thang du phebs so// gzims khang grog kha ru rin po cher/ rdog pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun bshad bka' dang bcas pa dgos zhes zhus pas/ rje'i gsung nas dbus gtsang phyogs na bla ma mkhas 'dod rag langs pas bsnyen pa ma song bar dbang bskur byed lob mang po snang*/ nga rang gis dgyes rdor 'di la bsnyen pa mang po rag song bas/ thog ma cha 'di byed gsungs nas/ rdog lugs kyi dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/

mngon dkyil sogs dang*/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ 'grel pa zin bris chen mo/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ dgyes rdor gyi sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ (13 na 25)bdag med lho mo bco lnga'i byin rlabs dang sgrub thabs/ mahā mā ya'i rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa zin bris chen mo/ sgrub dkyil dang bsre 'pho'i dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum la sogs pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rdog pa'i zab chos skor/ dbang nyams chen mo/ nā ro pa'i gdugs kyi yu ba'i 'grel pa zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rje mar pa'i shog dril bzhi pa/ dgu pa/ bco lnga pa/ chos drug mkhar dkar ma la sogs pa bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung dang*/ na ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus/ gtum mo ka dpe/ rim lnga bsdus gsal/ stag lung thang pa chen po'i chos drug yid bzhin nor bu rnams khrid du mdzad do// mi la dang*/ phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs/ mkhas pa 'jigs med grags pa'i yig ca'i steng nas/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang*/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa bskyed rdzogs las tshogs dang bcas pa gsan no// chos rje zur bzhugs par mos gus srog gi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ 'bri stag gi zab chos bka' 'bum gyi rim pa mud dag tu nyan par mdzad do// de dus paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'bum phrag gsum pa bya rgod gshongs zhes klog pa'i chos grwa gtsugs nas ring zhig na/ gang spong ba bsam gtan la mngon du phyogs pa skabs der gdan 'dzom pa na/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyis/ rje btsun 'di la bla ma zhang g.yu brag pa'i sprul pa'i sku yin pas de nyid kyi chos skor tshad pa zhus shig pa dang*/ sngon ra lung du gnas bskor la phebs pa'i tshe yang*/ tshul de lta bu la bskul pa'i lung bstan zhig byung ba dang mthun nas/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon por yid ches pa'i dad pa mi phyed par thob nas/

dam pa nyid kyi drung du nan tan gyis gsol ba btab ste/ mkhas pa de nyid dang*/ ljang bla ma gsang ste ba dang bcas tshogs pa shin tu mang por zhang gi bka' rgya khrid du gnang ngo*// gzhan rnams lung du stsal cing*/ (13 ba 26)sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung dang*/ rgyal dbang bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis skal ldan rnams tshim par mdzad do// phyir yang na lan+dar mkhyen rab rin po che mjal ba na rje'i gsung nas/ byang ris pha gi tshon bla ma na bza' dang 'chor po bzhugs khri dang mthon po mang po rang zhig bzhugs yod par 'dug /da lta'i stag lung chos rje 'di pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba cig yod 'dug pas/ da lam stag lung chos drug cig gsan las che zhes ku re dang*/ thugs dam skyong tshul gyi gnad shin tu rig par dka' ba mang du dri ba mdzad pa na/ ji lta ba'i lan gyis sgro 'dogs gcod par mdzad pas dgyes pa chen por gyur to/ de nas gtsang ra lung du phebs/ zhig gsos 'phro rnams mdzad do// gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba la 'jigs pa med pa 'dar pa seng ge bzang po byon pa la gsung chos mang du gnang ngo*// de dus gzhu kun dga' ra bar 'gran zla med pa'i mi'i dbang po don yod rdo rje mchod yul du/ stag lung pha rin po che phebs pa mjal te/ mkhas pa bo dong pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi cho ga rgyas pa'i steng nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i tshe dpag med yum can gyi dbang dang sgrub thabs/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud/ 'grel chen la yag pa byang chub dngos grub kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas tshogs bshad kyi tshul gsan no// de ltar mkhas pa dang grub pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis blo gros kyi bum pa khengs par mdzad do// de dus sde pa sgar nas dam pa'i chos las byung ba'i dri ba shin tu mang ba gnang ba la lan chos bzhin du blon par mdzad pa na dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar las snyan pa'i bstod tshig gi 'od zer 'phro bar mdzad do// de nas shin tu yos kyi lo 'gro mgon bsod dbang dang phyag chen chos dbang gis mgo byas ri ba bzang rags chos kyi dga' ston chen pos tshim par mdzad nas/

tsa ri trar brdzangs so// de'i phyi lo lto yon phyogs kyis byin gyis rlob pa'i ched du gdan drangs par phebs te/ 'gro (14 na 27)ba'i tshogs dam pa'i lam bzang la bkod do// me mo sbrul lo bya yul chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan 'dren gtos che ba sleb te mi 'gyad par phabs par zhal gyis 'chos te/ thog mar stag lung du byon pa rin po che'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams bsgrubs so// de nas mkha' lding dbang po'i rigs can gyi rgyal po'i bka' ngor phebs par zhugs pa na/ yar klungs rtse zhabs drung gis ja 'dren gnang*/ ha la sgang du mkhas pa'i dbang po 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang dang*/ mkhas pa kun mkhyen pas gtsos pa'i 'dus pa dag la bka' 'grel gnang bas dpon slob kun mi bskyud pa'i dad pa thob par byas so// g.ye spel sngon du sprul pa'i sku dpon g.yog sna len du phebs te thabs gcig par/ pho brang chos rgyal lhun por mngon par mtho ba'i 'byor pa zad mi shes pa la ci dgar spyad do// de nas rje btsun ras chung pa 'ja' lus brnyes pa'i gnas/ grub thob gling gi gzims phug lo gro mog pa lha rtsa zhes par phebs te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos kyi grags pa dang*/ dus 'khor zhabs shākya dbang phyug /shar kong po'i mkhas pa sangs rgyas bskyangs dang*/ khri lcam don yod sgrol ma la sogs pa che gnyan gyi 'dus pa mang dag la/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ nā ro pa chen po'i chos drug /gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo/ lam zab bla ma sgrub pa/ chos kyi sgo'i gnad kun 'doms pa rten 'brel rabs bdun la sogs pa'i khrid dang*/ bde mchog mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang bcas mang du stsal lo// de nas gsal rje sgrub sde pad+ma dkar por phebs nas bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yab bka' yum bka'/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i khrid lung yongs su rdzogs par gnang ngo*// rgyal dbang gnyis par bde chen skor gsum la sogs pa'i zab khrid thor bu ba gsan te/

dpon slob lhan du tsa ri tra mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang por phebs so// gnas gsar rnying gi ri ba rnams kyis bsu ba zhabs tog phun sum (14 ba 28)tshogs par byas so// der tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ mtsho mchod/ dar 'phan/ 'gyed bzang po bsam pa'i yul las ches brgal bstsal bas/ lus can rnams dga' ches pa'i dbang gis rtab rtab por 'gyel to// de dus phyags phyir/ tshogs chen mkhan po bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' bkra shis pa sogs mang du phebs pa la/ phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i gdams ngag khor mo nyid du gnang ngo*// de'i tshe cig car phur 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha' la gzigs pa dang mnyam du thugs nyams 'bar ste bro brdungs pas/ rdo ba la 'jim par byas pa bzhin/ zhabs kyi pad+mo rab tu gsal bar bkod do// gzhan yang so so'i thad du 'od phung 'khrigs pa/ gri gug dang rin po che la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa mang po dang*/ yi dam lha'i gzugs brnyan ji snyed pa shar ba la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i rtags gzhal bar dka' ba mang du byung kyang*/ de ni 'di dang 'di'o zhes rgyas par mi gsung ngo*// de yang*/ ji ltar rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gsangs pas 'grub par bshad pa de nyid gzhan la bstan pa'i ched kho na yin no zhes kho bo cag bsam mo// tshur phebs te mi dbang bkra shis dar rgyas la dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba stsal cing*/ ljongs de'i rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs dang bcas pa'i phyag gi gnas/ mchod pa'i rten/ bkur sti'i yul gcig pur gyur nas gtsang du phebs so// shel dkar rgyal rtse nas mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po sog po 'phags kyis 'bul ba gya nom pas mchod par bgyis so// de nas skyid shod dus skyong don yod rdo rje dang*/

bya bkra shis dar zhing rgyas pa'i lha gnyis phebs par 'jig rten las brgal yang 'jig rten gyi srol lugs mi 'gong ba'i ched du gzhi len phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do// nang so rnam pa gnyis kyang (15 na 29)gus pa lhag par thob pas sri zhu'i gtso bor mdzad cing*/ bsngags pa chen po sgrogs pa la brtson pa lhur byed do// de nas gdan sa chen po me tog mdangs 'phrog gi yang dben spos skya dkar chung ngu sku mtshams shin tu dam pa'i zhig mdzad rjes/ yang dbon du bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa lhag pa bskor nas/ lcags pho spre'u'i lo tsa ri cig car du 'gro mgon zung mkhar dbon po bsod dpal dang*/ phyag chen gyi mgo byas sgom chen mang dag brdzangs so// de nas gdan sa 'brug se byang chub kyi gling du phebs te/ gnam sdings dpal gyi ri khrod du gdan chags par mdzad/ 'dul ba'i sde mtha' yas pa la mtha' yas pa'i gsung gis/ sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang*/ gsung ngag ro snyoms kyis gtsos pa'i zab chos mang du gnang ngo*// de nas stag ri'i bar du phebs nas gnas kyi 'dzin bkod gya ba med pa bgyis te/ slar gdan sa chen po ra lung gi yang dgon rgyal ba'i pho brang du zla shas kyi bar bcad rgya shin tu dam par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin par 'byung po chen po zhig rang gi stobs ji snyed pas brgal ba na/ snying rje chen po dang blo gros kyi ya lad bzang po bgos pa/ sred med kyi bu'i stobs mnga' ba/ byams pa'i mtshon cha rnon pos rmeg med par bcom mo// slad chan gzhan la gnod pa yang mtshan thos tsam gyis zhi ba'i mthu can du gyur to/ lho brag nas bla ma bsam gtan pa/ drung nas lca pa rgya bo/ rnal 'byor chen po lha btsun pa/ lho nas drung chen po pa la sogs pa'i mang du 'dus pa'i dga' ston mdzad do// dgun 'brug tu phebs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te/

rim pas brag thog dgon par dkar brgyud pho brang lha khang bcas pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad nas/ lhor phebs so// pa gro stag tshang u rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma sam+bha wa'i sgrub gnas de nyid du zla ba bzhi tsam gyi ring gcig pu nyid (15 ba 30)du bzhugs pa'i dus/ lhongs dang zil che bas thugs dam gyi rtsal cher rgyas par gyur te/ rnam pa gang shar thams cad sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol par 'char bar byung gsung*/ de grol rjes gdul bya rnams 'dul bar rim gyis thegs pa na/ grub thob chen po thang stong rgyal po'i dbon po bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po mjal du byon pa la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa dang sna len yang dag pa gnang ngo*// de nas tshur phebs nas gdan sa chen po'i kun dga' ra bar sku mtshams mus nas/ bar 'brog rdor gling gi gdan sa ba/ yar klungs nas gter mdzod rab 'byams pa 'dar ba rab 'byams pa la sogs pa'i/ dbu che dang chos ldan gyi sgom chen mang du tshogs pa la dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ zhang dang*/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum la sogs pa dbyar gyi ring gsung chos kyis khor mo yug tu 'das pa dang*/ rgyal dbang rjes 'debs pa gnang ba'i 'od gsal sgang sgom sde'i dge 'dun rnams la sbyar nas/ spos skyar sgrub khang sum cu lhag pa 'debs pa mdzad do// ra lung bod dang nying ro nas sgrub pa'i las rkyen mang du gtsugs/ sems can thams cad kyi phan bde'i rin po che ma lus pa 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi rgya mtsho nyid du gyur to/ chu mo phag gi la rje mar pa'i gdan sa gro bo lung gi gtsug lag khang chen po/ drung kun dga' bsam gtan pas zhig gsos legs par grub nas gdan 'dren sleb/ hor zla bdun pa'i nang du phebs nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba'i bltas bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gro kun dang bar byas so// de nas ra lung du phebs/ tsa ri nas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bstan pa rgya mtsho/

rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag lha btsun kun dga' chos rgya ma/ brag thog rab 'byams pa la sogs pa'i 'dus pa mang dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa nas/ tsa ri trar 'gro mgon jo bo dang*/ phyag chen mgo byas/ byi ba lo la rdzong dar mdzad do// 'dar ba rab (16 na 31)'byams pa seng ge rtse ba'i bdag po yum sras kyis mchod pa'i yul du brdzangs so// de nas hor zla gnyis par lho nas bla ma sgang stag pa'i gdan 'dren pas sleb ste/ lhor phebs/ theng thim/ pa gro la gtogs pa ling sbang rus spang zhus/ sgad stags yul gsar gyis phyed gnam phyed bla ma sku mched kyis bsngo rten du phul lo// de nas tshur phebs te/ gzhis ka rin chen spungs pa'i skyed tshal kha ru steng du zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs te/ gnyen chen/ mkhar ba/ 'dar/ bo dong pa la sogs pa'i nang so dang drung 'khor/ phyogs 'dus kyi dge 'dun mang dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs shig tu/ ral lnga lcang gseb tu gzims gur mdzad/ mi dbang don yod rdo rje yab yum gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ rdo rje slob dpon du rje btsun chen po nyid bzhugs lha btsun chen po sogs 'gran zla med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du tshogs te/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i dbu thod dam tshig gi rdzas bzang pos bkang ste/ nyid kyi phyag tu bzhes nas/ gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus su 'chad pa gnang ste/ dkar brgyud bro mo che 'debs pa mdzad pa na/ 'dus pa thams cad tshe 'di'i zhan 'khris rang sar grol/ dad pa chen pos rtse gcig tu 'das so// 'chi med kyi rdzas dam pa thog mar gsol ba gnang*/ de nas sde pa yab yum gyis gsol te rim gyis bskor ba na/ mi dbang chen pos/ 'brug ra lung zer ba'i sgra bo che/ ngag dbang chos rgyal 'byon pa'i snga rtags su 'dug ces sogs nyams dbyangs gnang ba na/ de nyid kyi lan thog lag tu/

gzhis ka rin chen spungs pa 'di la/ pho brang yongs kyi g.yang cig chags/ mi dbang don yod rdo rje 'di la/ chos rgyal yongs kyi g.yang cig chags/ 'dir tshogs drung 'khor dra ma'i tshogs la/ rdo rje spun gyi g.yang cig chags so// zhes mgur chen gyi dbyangs rta la (16 ba 32)drangs te gsung bar mdzad pas/ 'dus pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa chen po'i zil gyis brgyal ba bzhin du gyur to/ de nas lho'i yul ljongs su thogs te/ dgun pa gro bsam gtan rtse mor/ drung nas nyi zla bas thog drangs rnams la/ gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo/ dwags po rin po che'i bka' 'bum la sogs khrid lung mang du gnang ngo*// de nas gdan sa gong 'og gi 'dzin skyong mi dman pa'i ngang nas/ 'brug tu gtsug lag khang la zhig gsos phran bu dang*/ yang dgon gyi zhig gsos/ dgon pa'i dbye 'gyed la sogs mdzad do// lha sa po ta lar/ spyan snga rin po che chos kyi grags pa phebs pa mjal/ gsung chos kyi 'brel ba tsam gsan nas/ ra lung du byon/ sa pho 'brug lo 'gro mgon ye shes dbang po dang*/ phyag chen shes rab dbang pos mgo byas ri thes gtos che ba tsa ri trar brdzangs so// bu ma kun dga' bsam gtan pa'i nang rten/ chos rje lce sa pa dpon slob kyis bsgrubs pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad de/ bgrang bas dben pa'i 'bul tshogs kyang mang du phul lo// skabs shig tu rong 'phred mor sde pa sgar pa dang mjal de dus chag lo tsa ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ja 'dren dang bcas pa zad mi shes pa'i 'dod dgu'i tshogs la spyad do// de nas drung khra phu ba dpon slob kyis gdan 'dren zhus te/ mdo mkhar du phebs/ chos dbang du ma gnang nas/ dgun 'brug tu gsung ngag ro snyoms dang gzhan yang khrid lung mang du gnang ngo*// de dus lha sar jo mjal la phebs/ sde pa dga' ldan pa nang so chos rje'i drung gi gdan 'dren pas sleb/

tshal du byon nas/ zab pa dar rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyis bzhed pa gang bar mdzad/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod de/ rim pas gtsang du phebs so// lho brag tu grub pa'i dbang phyug lces pas gdan drangs/ 'phrin las kyi ba dan rab tu bsgreng bar mdzad do// (17 na 33)ra lung du shangs bde chen pa'i dbon po chos skyong bzang po dang*/ dwags sgom rab 'byams pa sogs gsar 'dus rnams la bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi dbang khrid yongs su rdzogs par gnang ngo*// de nas 'brug tu phebs/ khams pa chos mdzad bsod nams chos 'phel ba dang*/ chos rgyal mtshan pa phyag phyir sleb bo// de dus sde pa sgar nas zhal ngo rnams dang lhun po rtser mjal/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' chen po smyug la paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ngag dbang grags pa mjal du phebs te re zhig zhabs phyir byon/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dbang khrid lung mang du gnang bas thugs kyi bzhed don gang bar byas so// dpon lob rnams gdan sa ra lung du phebs/ 'gro mgon sku skye dang*/ phyag chen rin chen dbang pos mgo byas/ gsung gi bdud rtsis ngoms par mdzad mkha' spyod dbang po'i bstan skyong la brdzangs so// de yang*/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi bstan pa 'dzin par bya ba ni/ klog pa thos bsam dang*/ spong ba bsam gtan las gzhan gang yang yod par ma gzigs shing*/ gzhan la sman pa'i yon tan chen po mngon par bsgrubs pa la chog mi shes pa'i chos nyid 'di dang yang ldan pa lags pas ji ltar thos pa de dag gi nges pa'i don mngon sum du gtan la phab par dgongs te/ dka' thub pa'i gnas mang du brtags pas/ chos rje khu dbon gyi gdan sa'i nyi 'og /grub pa brnyes pa mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa/ dben pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis blta na sdug par byas pa/ gnod sbyin gyi dge bsnyen gang ba bzang po'i pho brang gi shar logs/ kha ro lung par dkon mchog gis lung bstan pa'i dus la nye bar bab par gzigs so// spos skya'i gzigs khang du rang byon khyad par 'phags pa rnams mchod rdzas rgya mtshos mchod cing*/

dge 'dun gyi 'dus pa la dga' ton chen po dang bcas pas/ dbon sku bgres pa'i gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan (17 ba 34)ngag gi dbang po grags pa dpal bzang por gsol/ dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs dang*/ byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa gnang nas/ khu dbon lhan du/ chu pho spre'u lo dgung lo zhe brgyad pa/ hor zla dang po'i nang du me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs nas phyogs der phe bla so/ thog mar zla ba lhag pa sku mtshams shin tu dam pa zhig mdzad de/ sgrub khang bzo dgos rnams legs par bsgrubs so// de dus mnga' ris gu ge nas mkhas pa kun dga' rnam rgyal ba byon te phyag phyir bzhugs/ bug sgo nas 'brug skor gyi zab khrid phal che ba gnang ngo*// bya btang 'brug sgra rgya mtsho zhes 'dogs pa gnang*/ zhal slob kyi dngas mar gyur/ phyis bstan pa la phan pa'i bya ba cher byas so// der nang so sgar pa don yod rdo rje'i legs bya'i 'bul ba gtos che ba dang*/ bya yul nas rgyal dbang sprul pa'i skus brtan bzhugs dang 'bul tshogs rgya chen po dang bcas pa dbon po bde chen pa brdzangs te phul lo// de'i tshe smyug la chos rje sku mtshams khongs phebs pa'i zhu 'phrod byung ba slar brdzangs so// sna dkar rtse nas nang so'i gdan 'dren byung yang phebs pa ma gnang ste/ skyes bu dam pa thams cad ni/ mang po khas kyis mi 'che la/ rdo ba la bris pa'i ri mo bzhin du dam bcas pa las 'da' ba ni mi srid pas so// slad mar gsol dpon sleb nas zhal ngo rnams drung du phebs par gsol ba'i zhu 'phrod kyang phyir skabs su mi bab par gsol nas/ shin tu dben pa'i ngang nas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi ring 'dag sbyar gsung bcad shin tu dam pa la bzhugs so// chu bo chen po'i rgyun nam/ mar ma'i rtse mo bcings pa lta bur/ rdo rje'i theg pa la lhag par gnas pas/ rlung bcu dbu mar zhugs te pra phab pa'i snang ba bzhin du rtags bcu la sogs pa 'byam klas pa'i snang ba nyi ma'i 'od zer chu nang du shar ba lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan dpe 'bar ba ji snyed pa gzigs pas (18

na 35)stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i rdo rje'i sku 'grub cing*/ 'jig rten gyi sgra thams cad las 'das pa'i nā da'i rang sgras 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i gsung rdo rje dang*/ zag pa med pa'i phung po mkha' khyab 'od gsal ba'i rdo rje can gyi thugs dang*/ yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi'i bde ba la sems ro gcig tu brtan pa'i/ re zhig na khams thams cad gyen du gshegs pa gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo khengs pa/ 'gyur ba med pa las skyes shing 'gyur ba rnam par nyams pa/ gang gi reg na phung po dang khams dang dbang po la sogs pa mtha' dag 'dzag pa'i bde ba thams cad kyis bye ba'i char yang bsgrun du med pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i sku nyams su brtas pa'i/ ye shes kyi rdo rje mngon sum du grub par gyur to/ deng dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin las byung ba'o snyam du dgongs nas byas pa drin du bzo ba'i mos pa chen po'i chen po la gnas pa'i mthus rdo rje'i mgur 'di tho lag tu 'then no// na mo mahā mu drā ya/ rje mtshan ldan bla ma chos kyi myang du stsal lo// phag lo shar 'phral/ sku mtshams yangs su gnang ste/ dgung seng la bla g.yer 'thon pa mdzad/ de yang*/ snga mo nyid nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung yod do cog gsan par bzhed pa las/ de dus cig car rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po snyan pa rgya mtsho/ bya ba thongs shing dam pa'i spyod pa la shin tu goms pa/ rang gi bu slob nang gtsang bar dgongs nas gdan drangs so// ra lung nas gsung rab rnams len par mdzad/ lung gsan pa'i dbu btsugs/ der rnal (18 ba 36)'byor gyi dbang po drung lce sa pa/ bya btang rin po che shes rab pa/ zhi byed pa chen po la sogs pa/ bla ma dbu che chos ldan gyi 'khor 'dus pa shin tu tshabs ri sul de nyid til gyi gang bu bzhin du khengs par gyur to/ de dag la phyag chen/

chos drug /sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung ngag mang du bug sgo nas stsal lo// lo bzhi 'das nas sku mtshams grol ba gnang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ra lung nas kha ror byon/ rje btsun mi tra dzo ki'i thugs dam brgya rtsa'i dbang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'am/ mtshan gzhan jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha yab sras kyi bka'i glegs bam/ dpal sa ra ha chen po dang mi gnyis pa'i rje btsun chen po 'ba' ra ba'i chos drug chen mo sogs mang du gsan no// de'i tshe/ gnas gsar nas nang so zhal ngo thams cad dang*/ shar kong po'i rnal 'byor pa bde chen rol pa sogs mang du byon pa rnams/ rgya che ba'i chos kyi snang ba chen pos mchog gi lam la 'god par mdzad do// kong po dang*/ lho brag sgrub sde nas rta 'bul gtos che ba sleb/ de dus chos rje rdo rje 'dzin pa/ grub thob g.yul rgyal rdzong pa chos kyi shes rab dang*/ bla ma bstan pa brgya byin gyis gtsos pa'i cog pu ba brgya phrag bzhi lhag pa bya yul du rgyal dbang gnyis pa'i zhabs phyir brdzangs so// ting ting nas chos mdzad sogs zhabs phyir gsar pa mang du tshogs ra lung du phebs te/ dga' sngon chen pos ring zhig 'das nas/ 'dus pa rnams cog pu ba chos ldan kho nas sgrub pa snying po ra len pa'i sde btsugs so// de rjes gdod nas dag pa'i dur khrod chen po tsa ri trar/ 'gro mgon dpal 'byor lhun grub dang*/ phyag chen byams pas mgo byas ri pa rdzong dar gnang ngo*// de yang*/ spangs pa drung rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa/ (19 na 37)tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po mnga' ba/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos thams cad la shin tu mkhas pa/ mthong ba dang*/ thos pa/ dran cing reg pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho skems par 'gyur ba'i dpal ldan bla ma de nyid/

bsdu ba bzhi'i sgo nas mchog dang*/ bar ma dang*/ tha ma'i gdul bya rnams/ skye rga na 'chi'i rba glong drag tu 'khrug pa'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba dang*/ re ba dang*/ dogs pa'i zhags pas dam por bcings pa dgrol ba dang*/ mya ngan gyis gdungs pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi lam chen po la bkri ba'i tshad du// chos ldan gyi 'khor brgya phrag gnyis las mi nyung bas nyi 'og dbus kyi rgyal khams chen por byon no// der mdo mkhar dang*/ 'brug tu phebs/ lam bar gyi lus can kun gyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing dam par gyur bzhin pa dang*/ sne'ur sde pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang mjal te/ lha sar sgar phab nas re zhig bzhugs so// der khrom gyi tshogs la khyams khra steng nas gsung chos mang du gnang zhing*/ grol dbang khyams khra shod du gnang ngo*// phyir rim pas 'brug tu phebs so// dgun chos grol rjes/ tshal nas nang so chos rje phebs/ nyams snang dang bcas par bde mchog gi dbang dang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po yab sras kyi zab khrid kyang mang du stsal lo// de'i khrid gnyer ba gang gi gsung skyes/ drug kun dga' rgyal pos byas so// de dus phyogs mtha' nas chos byed gsar bu mang du tshogs/ de nas gtsang stag ri'i bar du phebs/ dbyar khang ltag gi gzims khang zhig gsos mdzad/ gzhi byed nor bu dga' ldan pa'i slob dpon pa la sogs pa dge 'dun 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs la gsung gi bdud rtsi'i char chen pos dge legs kyi myu gu bskyed par mdzad do// de nas ra lung du phebs/ rgyal rtser byon te ne'u thang du sgar (19 ba 38)phaṭa/ chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis gzhi len phun sum tshogs par zhus/ lum pa nas chos mdzad la sogs pa chos sde nas dge 'dun mang 'dus dang*/ skye bo'i khrom chen po la dam pa'i chos mang du gnang ngo*// skabs der dbus gtsang du dus 'khrug chen mo byung ste/

rang gi bde ba phyag dur khrod kyi rtswa bzhin du dor nas bya dka' ba chen pos gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la sngon yun ring mo nas goms par bgyis pa de'i mthus/ skabs der dbus phyogs su phebs bzad ma dar spyan snga rin po che bzhugs pa'i sar byon nas/ gong ma chen po dpon blon gong dkar na bzhugs pa la zhu skor phul zhing*/ gzhis ka ba'i sgar gral thang na yod par dpon slob byon te/ 'jags dan la 'khyol bas dus kyi 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzad do// de nas 'brug tu phebs lam ljang 'phrad du/ chibs nor bu bsam 'phel cung zad bug pa'i rnam par gyur pas/ rjes chibs kha ba 'phrin las par ci 'dug ltos gsung ba bltas pa na/ rdo ba'i dogs la de'i rjes shin tu gsal bar bkod pa mthong nas/ de gsol pas/ mtshan dal dor zhig ces bka' phebs pa bzhin bgyis so// de yang sku tshe dang 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs par mngon no// gdan sa 'brug seb byang chub kyi gling nas mi ring bar/ sde srid phag mo gru pa dpon blon la gsol ja zhu bar sne'ur byon/ klu sdings su sgar mdzad rim pas lha sa rdo rags khar bzhugs/ ka ṇi bshag tu che sa rin po ches sna len yang dag pa gnang*/ rta ra bshag tu blon chen nang so rin chen rgyal mchog pas thog ma'i bka' 'brel gsan ci pa/ bsti stang chen pos mnyes par byas so// yar rgyab nang so la sogs pa mi dbang du mas mchod 'os dang bstod pa'i gnas su bgyis so// de nas tshal du phebs/ nang so chos rje'i rnam dpyod kyi bum pa ldegs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsis gang bar mdzad de/ (20 na 39)'brug nas ra lung du phebs lam yang*/ ljang 'phrang gi yar zur/ chibs snga ma de nyid kyis/ gor ma sa la rjes snga ma las kyang ches gsal ba zhig bkod pa de 'dor bar ma nus pas/ skye dgu'i las dar nyon mongs pa'i chu bo skem pa'i byed pa po/ dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i rgyu nyid du ding sang yang mchis so// gdan sa chen po ra lung thel du gdan chags par mdzad/

dge slong kun dga' bzang skyong bas gtsos pa'i cog pu ba rnams lho mon du rdzong dar mdzad do// dgun gyi ring sku mtshams shin tu dam pa dang*/ dbyar ka gsung chos 'dzugs pa dang*/ cog sgar ba rnams phyir 'khor/ de dus nyang stod du gzings cher byung ba la brten/ chos sde dpal 'khor sde chen mkhan po'i gdan 'dren sleb nas/ phyogs der phebs te/ gzhi len yang dag pas mnyes par byas so// gzhi seng gi sgar du zhu 'phrin gnas skabs kyi khyad sda tsam byung zhing*/ de dus drung rab brtan pa sku mched la sogs pa gsar dus du mas sleb bo// de nas phyir phebs nas rim pas dbus phyogs thegs/ lam zhor mon rtse'i nye logs gzhis ka ba'i sgar du phebs shing*/ spo mthon rdzong du sde pa yar rgyab nas dpon chen sku mched dang*/ dga' ldan khang gsar nas nang so a bsod pa rnams la chos dbang phran tshogs gnang bar mdzad do// dbon sa rin po che dpon blon lhun po rtser bzhugs pa mjal/ sems can gyi bde skyid thob pa'i ched du rgyu mtshan 'bul bar mdzad pas/ 'chings 'thud yun re zhig mdzad do// de nas phyir phebs nas slad mar gdan sa 'brug tu byon/ theg chen yongs 'du'i gzims khang 'debs par gnang ngo*// lha sa ra jo bo rin po che mjal ba'i skabs/ nang so chos rjes gdan 'dren par gsol te/ bde chen rdzong du chibs kha bsgyur ba gnang nas/ re zhig gi bar du bzhugs (20 ba 40)te mi dbang de nyid 'khor bcas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung gi gsang bas kun nas dang ba'i rgyud mngon par gang bar bgyis so// de nas rim gyis gtsug gi phyogs su phebs pa na/ 'phyong rgyas pa nang so rin chen rgyal mchog pa dang*/ bya pa nang gyi chos mdzad pa sku 'khor bcas mjal bar byon no// de dag la ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang bcas te lugs gnyis kyi sna len gya nom par mdzad do// de rag gis 'bul ba'i rnam grangs kyang rgya cher phul lo// de nas 'gro mgon jo bo la/

bsko 'ja gnang sbyin bzang po stsal te lho brag sgrub sde'i bla mar brdzangs so// dpon slob rnams lho dgon pa yul nas/ shar thing yul/ pa gro rnams su phebs/ bla ma dbu che yon bdag thams cad kyis mos pa chen pos yo byad yod do 'tshal gyis bstabs par byas so// 'brug 'phrin las sgang*/ glong rdzogs theg chen tshos 'khor/ pus mo rab brtan chos 'khor/ 'bras la bsam gtan chos 'khor/ bsam gtan rtse mo la sogs pa'i sgrub sde gsar 'debs mang du bgyis so// sgang mkhar gyi gtsug lag khang zhig gsos grub pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad de/ phyir gdan sar byon no// ring zhig lon pa na/ mdo mkhar du gdan drangs te/ phyag phyi'i cog sgar ba dang*/ ngang 'dus kyi tshogs pa mang po la/ rje btsun chen po nā ro pa'i gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo'i khrid kyis gtsos dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas dus dang rnam pa thams cad 'da' bar mdzad do// slar ra lung nas lho brag mkho mthing gser gyi lha khang du thegs/ de dus sman thang phur shin tu mkhregs pa'i gor ma sa la zhabs kyi re khā ches gsal bar mchod pa'i zhing du bkod do// lha khang gsar pa bzhengs pa'i dkar brgyud bla ma'i sku rnams rab tu gnas par mdzad do// lha khang gdan sa pa dang*/ rtogs ldan chen po ngag dbang lhun grub pa la sogs pa bka'i bdud rtsis yid dga' ba thob par bgyis so// khra lha khang ma 'cham pa'i bsdums kyang mdzad/ btson khang du gnas pa mang po mi 'jigs pa'i (21 na 41)gnas la 'god par mdzad nas/ ra lung du phebs so// 'gro mgon bde chen pa dang*/ phyag chen pa sangs blos mgo byas sgo mtshan mang du tsa ri trar ye shes kyi 'khor lor brdzangs so// gser mdog can nas mkhas pa chen po 'bum rab 'byams pa dge 'dun nyi ma dang*/ smyug la rab 'byams pa la sogs pa la 'brug skor gyi zab khrid mang du stsal nas dbus phyogs su phebs so// snams mda' lo mo nang du sgar gnang zla ba gsum tsam gyi ring bzhugs/

dbon rin po che sku bgres pa dang*/ drung nas kun dga' lhun grub pa dpon slob bdun cu tsam dang*/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen/ sgar pa'i dbu mdzad chen mo ting ting chos mdzad/ nang so ljang smyon la sogs pa cog sga ra ba'i dge 'dun phyed dang sum brgya lhag pa dang bcas pa la/ dkar brgyud gser 'phreng*/ mar pa nas rgyal dbang rje'i bar gyi bka' 'bum/ bla ma zhang rin po che/ rgyal ba lo rgod gnyis kyi bka' 'bum/ mkhas grub chen po o rgyan pa'i gsung 'phreng ba skror rnams kyi lung dang*/ dbang rnon cho ga cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i sar bkri ba'i gdam ngag rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub zla seng pa'i lugs yongs su tshang ba nyams khrid du gnang ngo*// dus der skye bo 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa la khro bo med cing byams pa'i dbang gis btang snyoms su bzhag mo de lta na'ang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis chad pas tshar bcad do// gang la 'brel pa thogs pa'i mthu chen pos 'khor ba las thar pa'i rgyur gyur to/ de dus 'brug tu sku mtshams mur re zhig bzhugs nas yar klungs su phebs/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtser gong ma rin po che mjal/ zhabs 'degs gya nom pa bteg ste/ thel rtses thang tshogs chen mo'i dge 'dun mang dag dam pa'i chos kyi zil dar phun sum tshogs pas yid sim pa thob par byas so// de nas sal la la brgyud/ byang stag lung du phebs/ gling pa rnams kyis bkod pa chen pos ya thang nas bsus/ chos rje rin po cher 'bul ba dang*/ tshogs pa'i rnam gzhag gya nom bstsal lo// de dag gis mchod pa'i phung po kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa (21 ba 42)'gran par bzod pas bla mar byas so// hor khang nas nang so yab yum dang*/ mkhan slob kyis gtsos pa rnams dbang khrid lung gis skal ba ji lta ba'i lam la drangs te/ dpon slob rnams tshur phebs/

ras chen nam mkha' blo ldan gyis karma gling gi dgon pa phul ba rtsis bzhes/ zab don chos kyi 'khor lor ming btags te/ chos 'khor chen po lha sar phebs so// dus de dag tu 'phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de nas sde srid rin po che mchod yon phebs par bsu ba ser sbreng mdzad/ yon mchod thams cad kyis mang ja 'gyed 'bul gnang dang bcas pa yang dag pa mdzad do// de dus bsam sde nas mi'i dbang po tsa ri dbang phyug grags par dbang lung la sogs pa mang du gnang zhing*/ mchod yon gyi drung 'khor rags pa dang*/ gsang ne'u thog la sogs pa nas byon pa'i che gnyan gyi 'dus pa mang dag la gsung gi gsang ba zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du stsal lo// gnas skabs der chu'i 'jigs pas lha sar gnas pa dag gtses par gyur pa/ thabs gang gis kyang bzlog par ma nus pas/ rab tu dngas te/ kun gyis spyan snga rin po cher gsol ba btab pa na/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ 'brug pa rin po che rten 'brel gyi bdag po yin pas der gsol ba 'thad ces phebs pas/ yon mchod thams cad kyis gsol ba 'debs pa la zhugs so// de'i tshe rje btsun chen pos rags stod smad par gsum du grub thob o ḍi ya ṇa pa chen po'i gsung 'phreng bskor gsum gnang ba'i nub mo de nyid la chu rnams par bzlog par gyur te/ 'jigs pa las grol nas kun ngo mtshar zhing lhag pa'i dad pa thob/ yid mgu zhing tshim pas bkur sti byas so// de nas gdan sa chen po 'brug tu phebs/ gnam sdings ri khrod du dpon slob thams cad zla ba gsum gyi bar spyil pos ma khebs pa rnams la cog pu dang rang shong khang bu bsgrubs te bcad rgya shin tu ngam par mdzad do// der dbon rin po che sku bgres par brtag pa gnyis pa 'grel pa rin chen rgyan 'dra'i steng nas zin thun dang bshad pa rdzogs par gnang ngo*// de nas sku mched drung che sar 'don pa'i sta gon grub nas/

me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs ra lung thel du (22 na 43)phebs so// de dus dbus gtsang gis kun 'brum nag gi nad kyis gang bas bka' bgros pa rnams yid nem nur du gyur to/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis ni/ 'dod dbang rtsa lag dang bcas pa'i dpung yang byams pa'i mtshon chas pham par mdzad cing sred med kyi bu yang stobs kyis zhum zhum par byed pas/ mi ma yin gyi tshogs kyis gnod par bgyid ga la nus/ bsrung ma'i babs dag las kyang de ltar gsol bas/ nyes pa cung zad kyang mi yong par dgongs so// de nas khyung mchog gi lo chu stong can gyi dkar po'i phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' dang po rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la/ gangs ri chen po ti se nas rgya nag rgyal po'i pho brang la thug gi bar nas 'dus pa gang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i spong ba pa brgya phrag brgya tsam gyi dge 'dun dang*/ nyi ma 'bum phrag gcig las brgal ba tsam gyi 'khor gyi khyams chen por bkod pa'i khyab par thams cad kyis mdzes pa sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis spyad pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod cing phyag byas pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i bka' btags kyis phyag rgyas chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen por/ dbon rin po che sku mched mngon par dbang bskur ro// de yang lhun po gzi brjid 'bar bas ri gzhan rnams zil gyis gnon pa'am/ dri ma med pa'i kun gsal la 'od zer 'bum phrag 'phro ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis 'od gzhan mog mog por byed pa dang 'gran zla med pa'i dpa' bo gnyis kyis marngos ba yang 'dra'o// der gdan sa chen po thel nas spyan snga rin po che dang*/ sde srid gong ma chen pa dpon blon gyis bsko 'ja gnang sprin/ bya yul nas rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku'i gnang sbyin/ gzhis ka rin chen spungs pa dang*/ shel dkar rgyal rtse pa ste chos kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi sa gtsos pa'i mi'i dbang po mtha' dag gis lags rnga dang 'bul chas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos/

so byad sna tshogs pas gsol zhing bsti stang du byas so// de dus rje btsun chen po gang gis thog ma mdzad pa'i ngur smrig 'dzin pa rgya mtsho lta bus bkra shis (22 ba 44)pa brjod pa dang*/ mnga' gsol ba'i me tog kun tu 'thor ro// de'i nyin phyogs khor mo yug gi ri bo dbang po'i tshon gyis brgyan pa'i na bun mdzes pa blta bas mi ngoms pa dag gis kun nas g.yogs shing*/ nam mkha' rab tu dngas pa 'ja' dang 'od kyi dra bas phan tshun du sbrel ba'i gur dang*/ me tog gi char chen po rgyun mi 'chad par chal chil du babs so// de kun gyi mthun snang du grub pas/ thams cad gus pa bskyed pa'i rgyu chen por gyur to/ de nas spos skya gzin sa khang du rang byon khyad du 'phags pa rnams kyi zhal 'byed mdzad nas/ phyogs mtha' ba rnams yid ngoms par byas te rdzong dar mdzad do// khri thog rin po che rnam gnyis la 'khor lo sdom pa mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang*/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i gtum po lha nyer lnga ma/ khyung lnga phur gcig ma'i dbang byin rlabs/ lhan skyes dang*/ phag mo lhan cig skyes ma'i byin rlabs/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rgyas pa/ mi 'khrugs pa lha so bdun ma'i dbang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang*/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yab bka' bzhi dang yum bka' bzhi/ tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra jo tā ri'i lugs/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa rnams kyi dbang*/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang la sogs pa dbang khrid lung mang du gnang ngo*// de nas khu dbon gnyis dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po dang thabs gcig tu mtha' 'khob kyi 'gro ba 'dul bar dgongs te/ lho mon phyogs su phyogs bral gyi sgar 'debs par mdzad do// de dus bya yul nas/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa zhing gzhan du gshegs zhes bzod dka' ba'i gtam gyis sku mdun du son ma thag

/drung dpal rgyam pa sogs la mchod pa'i rdzas du ma dang bcas bstabs te rdzong dar mdzad do// dpon slob rnams phyir ra lung du phebs te bzhugs pa na/ bya yul nas rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku'i dbu rgyan srog zhu bzo dang rgyus 'jig rten na 'gran zla med pa zhig dang*/ hor gos ta hun gser ma'i beṭa thul khyad par ba dang*/ gser rtses srang gi zho brgya rnams/ rje'i drung du phul zhig ces 'da' dka'i (23 na 45)zhal chems su phebs pa nang so chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis yid dam du mdzad de dgongs rdzogs bsngo zhus su phul lo// nang rten gyi sku 'dra rin po che bzhed pa'i sku rgyu dang yon rdzongs/ zhal ngo drung tshor gnang cha gya nom pa dang bcas pa 'bul bar ting ting chos mdzad pa dang*/ shangs pa dga' bcu ba brdzangs nas dbus phyogs su phebs par mdzad do// 'phan yul nas gdan 'dren nan che ba'i stobs kyis/ zab don chos 'khor du byon no// stag lung nas mkhan chen pa la sogs pa'i 'dus pa mang dag dang*/ 'gro mgon thang po ba/ phyag chen sa bug pas mgo byas rnams la/ gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo la sogs pa'i dbang khrid mang du stsal lo// tsa ri tra'i 'dzin skyong du ri pa bzang rags rdzong dar mdzad do// de dus rgya ma khri dpon gyi brgyud pa sde pa mkhar rtsa bas spyan drangs te/ gsung chos mang du gnang*/ mi phyed pa'i dad pas rim gro cher bgyis so// de nas grub rgyal la sogs par phebs nas/ dga' ldan khang gsar gyi klu sdings su sgar mdzad de/ nang so chos rje dpon g.yog 'ga' la ro snyoms phyag rgya chen por sgang dril ba sogs dbang khrid mang du gnang ngo*// shing ro spre'u lo hor zla dang po shar 'phral/ sku mtshams bzhugs yul dkon mchog gis lung bstan pa bzhin/ rnal 'byor pa sa'i rdul snyed kyis grub pa chen po brnyes pa'i rdo rje'i gdan me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs gdan sa chen po ra lung thel zhes lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong bla na med pa de nyid kyi yang dgon rgyal ba'i pho brang gi kun snang bde chen khor yug tu lo gsum lhag tsam bcad rgya shin tu dam pa la bzhugs so// de'i tshe nyin thun gsum mtshan thun gsum bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor zab chos 'da' zhing*/

de dus rang byon kha snga pa ṇa'i drung du/ dbon rin po che sku gzhon pa'i gtsug phud bzhes/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub tu thugs bskyed ba gnang*/ de nas bzung dgung seng la/ bka' (23 ba 46)'gyur ro cog gi lung dang*/ phyag phyir cig car rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbon po ye shes rgyal mtshan pa dang sngags pa chos mgon po sogs chos don du gnyer ba rnams la/ tshoms steng shod du yol bas bcad pa'i ngos nas bde mchog dang phag mo lhan skyes/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lung sogs gnang bar mdzad do// de nas drung ngag dbang pa dpon slob brje len pa rnams la gsung mjal gnang*/ de'i skabs rang byon khyad du 'phags pa'i bzhugs khang gsar du bsgrub par bzhed nas/ rang byon kha sarba ṇa bzhugs pa'i gdung rus gong bu la/ gser zhun ma'i chus glan par mdzad pas/ yungs 'bru ltar dbyibs legs shing*/ ku mu ta bzang po dang kha ba dngul gyi mdangs bas kyang ches bkrag pa'i ring bsrel brgyad phyag mthil du babs pa na/ skye bo rmad du byung ba'i 'phrul mthong ba dag /gang byin rlabs thob pa la/ dad pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu 'di med du mi rung ba nyid do zhes sems par byed cing*/ mos pa rgya chen po'i sa bon bskrun pa la nan tan du gyur to// de ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na/ ngo mtshar ba'i rten rang byung ba thams cad kyi mchog las kyang mchog tu gyur pa'i gtso bo bcu phrag gnyis dang*/ bzhi lhag pa re re la bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten/ rje btsun chen po nyid kyi phyag mtho gang*/ mi tshad kyi rkang gdam/ seng khri gsar zangs/ bang rim bum gdan dang bre rnams dngul dkar/ bum pa gser ljang brdungs/ 'degs pad chos 'khor gdugs rnams byu ru/ mu men spos shel rnams las grub pa/ sgo rgyan g.yu spyad shin tu legs pa dang*/
