mu tig bzang po la sogs pas brgyan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che'i bkod pa ji lta ba/ phyir ljang gser gyi dra mig gis 'khor mo yug tu mdzes par byas pa rnams dang*/ rgyal dbang rje'i gdung bzhugs pa/ tshe 'phrul mchod rten thog tshad ma/ gser zangs las grub pa/ rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis blta na sdug pa dang*/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las pa rje snyi sgom bsod nams rin chen gyi li sku mi tshad ma dang*/ drung ma the bas/ bde dgyes la sogs (24 na 47)pa'i bris dkyil sgrub pa sogs/ rig byed mkhas pas sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa yin no// khams pa mched dang*/ bla ma rgyal mtshan pa rnams spyi blar bkod de/ dbu mdzad dge ma chos mdzad/ blo gros pa/ rab brtan pa/ ston chen pa/ rnam thos pa/ thugs rje dbang po/ 'ja' tshon pa/ dgun thung ba/ chos rgyal dpal bzang ba la sogs pa/ phyogs rer dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed gnyis tsam bgo bar mdzad/ lho byang du sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i brje len thog mar gnang ngo*// sku mtshams grol 'phral spos skya gzims khang du 'gro mgon shes rgyam pa dang*/ phyag chen chos rgyal gyis mgo byas rnams la/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang khrid mang du gnang nas tsa rir brdzangs so// de dus khri thog rin po ches sgom sde 'du khang zhig gsos mdzad pa'i rab tu gnas pa bgyis te 'brug tu phebs o/ gtsug lag chen mo zhig gsos mi dgos ka med du gyur nas/ bzo rig mkhas pa mang du 'dzom/ ar+gha'i cho ga mdzad/ gtsang khang 'og thog ma gtogs tshang mar bshig nas/ de'i dbyar phal cher grub par mdzad/ de nas 'phan yul phyogs su thogs te 'phrin las kyi rnga chen rab tu bsgrags pas gdul bya'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa khor mo yug tu tshogs pa rnams la gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi stsol bzhin par zab don chos 'khor du bzhugs so// de dus sa skya bdag chen rin po che ngag pa nye logs su phebs pa/

phan tshun skyes dang ja zhus sku'i nye bskor du gnas pa rnams kyis mjal ba dang bka' yi bdud rtsis blo gros gang bar mdzad pa sogs bla lhag pa'i 'brel zab mo mdzad do// de nas byang stag lung gi bar du phebs te/ mchod khang stong*/ gling pa/ hor khang*/ stag lung chos mdzad ma sogs kyis zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par mdzad do// phyir skyid shod nas dbus ri brgyud dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs so// de dus bu tshal nas sde pa ma che ba/ lha rin po ches thog drangs zhal ngo rnams la gsung chos mang (24 ba 48)du gnang sne gdong bdag mos sna len yang dag par zhus te/ yar klungs kyi bar du zhabs kyis bcags so// slad mar seng ge sgang dang*/ lum pa la sogs pa rnams su phebs/ mtha' yas pa'i skye bo rnams kyi bsod nams chen po skye ba'i zhing du gyur to/ ting ting chos mdzad pa tsa ri tra nyams rtogs cig tu 'char ba'i gnas chen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gdan sar bkod nas rdzong dang mdzad do// rim pas 'brug nas gtsang du phebs/ gzhis ka rin spungs kha ru steng du sgar mdzad nas/ dbon drung g.yung pa sku mched/ nang pa gnyer chen pa sogs drung du 'khor rnams la gsung gi gsang ba bla na med pa bstan no// de dus rgod tshang dbu thong mjal ba na/ sde pa dpon blon gyi gsung gis nye bar bskul nas/ cog pu ba sum brgya lhag pa tsam gyis bro mo che dang*/ dkar brgyud rin po che'i rdo rje'i mgur gyi tshogs 'bul bar byas pas/ gang du gnas pa rnams srid pa'i 'byor ba las yid 'byung bar gyur to/ de nas bla ma grags pa mtha' yas pas gdan 'dren byas par rim gyis phebs dus yang rgyab sde pa dpon chen pa mjal bar byon/ chos dbang thugs bzhed dang mthun pa gnang bar mdzad do// rim par nya mo phyogs nas stag rtser phebs/ gnas gsar du gdan drangs zhag shas bzhugs zhal ngo rnams la bka' dbang mang du gnang*/

rtse chen du phebs/ gnyer pa lhun chen sku mched rnams la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa stsal nas rgyal rtser phebs/ ne'u thang du sgar mdzad do// sde pa zhal ngo rnams dar mjal gzhi len phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ dus de dag tu ris med pa'i 'gro ba la/ chos kyi bdud rtsi ngo skal du stsal bas/ yid kyi gdung ba thams cad 'joms par byas pas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba phan pa dang bde ba thams cad mdzad pa/ theg pa gsum gyi lam la dwangs te zhib chen po yi grong khyer du bgrod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// de nas ra lung*/ lho mon phyogs la thed/ gro 'brug chos sdings kyi gtsug lag khang btab/ sos thed du 'brug 'phrin las sgang gi sgrub sde btsugs nas/ thim bu phyogs su phebs te/ spang rings zam gdong (25 na 49)du 'dug pho brang sdings dang*/ 'brug rab brtan sgang gi gzims khang*/ lha khang*/ sgrub sde 'debs pa'i bka' bkod mdzad nas sgang khar dang bcas pa'i phyogs su phebs/ phyir gdan sar lung du byon ma thag /shar kong po'i yul nas me rag mdo pa rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang pa dpon slob kyis gdan 'dren par nan gyis gsol ba na/ bstan pa'i ched dang gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ myur thabs su phebs par zhal gyis 'chos so// de nas chos ldan 'ga' zhig gi dpon slob gtos che ba phebs pa la mngon du phyogs so// yang gsum lhun po rtser che sa 'gro ba'i mgon po dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de/ gzhung rnam rgyal rab brtan du phebs so// der zhal ngo rnams dang rdo rje 'chang rngog ston gyi dbon brgyud thar pa gling pa sogs la bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad do// de dus gser tog gdan sa pa phyag phyir son/ rim pas yar rgyab rgyal chen gling du mi dbang yum sras rnams la chos dbang du ma gnang bar mdzad do// re zhig bzhugs par gsol kyang ma gnang ste/ mo nam mkhar rnam sras gling sogs brgyud de phebs par mdzad pa'i tshe nang so rnam sras gling pa dang*/

bying ba rnams kyis dgyes spro'i 'dod dgu dpag tu med pas kun nas mchod par byas so// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dam pa'i chos kyi sgra bsgrags pas dang ba'i myu gu cher bskyed do// de nas 'phyong rgyas su gdan drangs te/ sa skyong dbang po btsun mor bcas pa/ 'phags sde pa dpon slob/ bla ma mig bzhi pa/ bla ma rgod tshang pa sogs la gsung chos mang du gnang ngo*// gya ba med pa'i bkur sti'i tshogs rgya chen por spyod bzhin pa nas yar stong lhun po sgang du phebs so// sde pa zhal ngo rnams dang*/ byang chub sdings pa dpon lob rnams la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung ngag kyang mang du stsal bas mi phyed pa'i mos pa lhag par 'phel bar mdzad do// rim pas dwags por byon/ bhu ma lcang sgo pa sogs kyis srid zhu phul du byung ba bgyis te/ grum lung phu brgyud nas tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo cig car dpal gyi nags (25 ba 50)ljongs su phebs so// de dus rdo rje 'dzin pa chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpon slob kyis mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs pas sku'i mdun bsus te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yo byad mtha' yas pa'i tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+mo mngon par mchod do// gnas gsar rnying gi ri dza bzang rnams la mang ja bur 'gyed dang dar 'phan rnam gzhag sogs mi dman pa gnang ngo*// shar kong po'i skal bzang kyi gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin bzhin par phebs pa'i mus/ sum mkhar du drung ngag dbang pa dpon slob rnams bsu ba la byon no// rim pas bu chu gsang ba chen po'i gnas chen me rag mdo bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bde chen ha ha ra bzhad pa yongs 'du'i tshal du gcags mal gcig bzhugs so// de nas gzhis ka 'brug chos sdings su gdan chags par mdzad do// dad 'dus kyi khrom shin tu mang por sgrub pa'i thabs rgya mtsho lta bu'i yi dam gyi rjes su gnang ba stsal lo// der gzhi pa rnams kyis rta drel legs pa bcu gnyis kyis mgo byas pa'i brgya 'bul gyi tshogs mu med pa bgyis so// de'i tshe gdan sa chen por phebs dgos pa'i dus la bab pa na mnal lam du mi'u thung mdog nag pa shin tu khros pa'i tshul can mang pos cho 'phrul ston pa dang*/

dngos su bya rog gi sgra drag po sgrog pa dang*/ khrom gyi dbus su nam mkha' nas rdo 'phang ba sogs bsdud ma'i tshogs kyis bskul ma drag tu byung ba'i mthus phyir myur thabs su phebs pa la zhugs so// de dus cog pu ba phyed dang drug brgya tsam pa zhig /rgyal dbang karma pa bsen mo gnya' khrir bzhugs pa la ja zhus dang mjal bar brdzangs so// de nas dpon slob rnams rim pas mchims yul chab nag phyogs su phebs/ rtsa gong du lcags zam dbon po ba la sogs pa dang*/ yang dgon du sgrub sde pa rnams kyis 'bul ba dang zhabs tog rgya chen po zhus te/ zhag par bzhugs nas chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad do// de nas 'os shod du phebs/ sprin thog tu rgyal dbang rjes gzims khang btab pa'i sar/ sgrub pa'i sde yang gtsugs par (26 na 51)mdzad do// kho mthing lha khang du nyid kyi gzigs pa yang dag pa'i gdams ngag gzhan la 'doms par re zhig bzhugs te/ gdan sa pa sku mched rnams kyis ches mnyes pa'i rim gro phul du byung ba zhus so// phyir dol bkra shis rnam rgyal du phebs/ yar rgyab pa dpon sa yum sras rnams la khrid lung dang dbang bka' 'ga' zhig gnang*/ rim gyis gzhis ka gong dkar du phebs/ dpon sa yum gyis sna len yang dag par mdzad nas/ 'brug tu sgrub pa'i brgyags lo re bzhin 'chag med du nas khal brgya phrag re 'bul bar mdzad do// de nas 'brug tu phebs gtsug lag khang chen po'i logs bris rnams sgrub pa'i dus/ rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku'i zhal slob kun spangs rin po che sgyu ma'i gar mkhan nam mtshan gzhan shes rab rgya mtsho la sogs pa che gnyan gyi 'du tshogs/ ljang rnal 'byor chen po la sogs pa bstan pa la phan pa'i bya ba nus pa mang dag dang bcas pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma 'dus pa la/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*/ bla ma zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ nā ro pa chen po'i chos drug /lam zab bla ma mos gus kyi khrid la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo ris med par yongs su bskor/ der gtsug lag khang chen po'i logs bris rnams grub ste/ bde mchog bcu gsum mal brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad do// skabs der glo bo nas chos rje sgrol 'bum pa zhes mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug de yang byon te/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ phyag chen ngo sprod dang bcas pa gsan te gus pa chen po mdzad do// de nas gtsang du phebs nas ring por ma lon par khu dgon gsum ka lho phyogs su thegs/ pa gro 'brug chos sdings kyi gtsug lag khang steng shod kyi ri mo/ rten 'brel bsgrig pa dang*/ khyams steng shod kyi 'phro rnams yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs/ spang ring (26 ba 52)zas gdong gi lha khang sgrub sde dang bcas pa'i 'phro kun kyang grub par mdzad do// de dus shar phyogs nas spyan 'dren par nan gyis gsol ba'i ngor/ khri rin po ches phebs/ khu dbon gnyis rdo rgya thob tu sgrub sde lta khang dad bcas gzhi tshugs pa'i phyag nas la byon/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po la dbang dang chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad do// khrom shin tu che bar dbang gnang*/ de nas khu byug lar sa byin gyis brlabs nas sgrub sde'i rmad btings ming 'brug chos skyong pho brang du btags so// de nas rim pas 'brug chos sdings su phebs/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma dang*/ phyag na rdo rje lha nyer lnga ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs phag mo lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs dang khrom rnams la tshe dpag med lha dgu ma/ rags bsdus la gsung ngag ro snyoms kyi khrid/ spyi chos rje mar mi dang*/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' 'bum dang bcas pa gnang nas/ wang 'dul chos 'khor sgang du phebs so// de dus rgya gdung yan gyi gtso bsdus tshogs/ rgya mtshams su dgon gnas lha khang*/

lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i zhal bkod phyag nas dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// de nas rim par bod du phebs/ la phyir slob dpon bshes gnyen pas gdan drangs/ phag mo'i byin rlabs gnang*/ lha khang dang gdung khang la me tog 'thor ba mdzad do// de nas ra lung du phebs/ spos skyar zhig gsos phran bu dang rtsa brgyad gzims spyil gyi zhig gsos rdzogs par sgrubs te/ re zhig na rgyal rtser byon/ sde pa dang mjal bar mdzad/ mngon dga' nas sger du zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa zhus so// ri khrod dga' ldan nas lum pa chos mdzad dpon slob mjal du byon gsung chos yid bzhin du stsal bas blo yi re 'dod rdzogs par bgyis so// de dus khang gsar grwa tshang pa'i grwa khang gsar bcos la phyag nas mdzad/ dpon slob pas thog drangs (27 na 53)thams cad la gsung chos kyi 'brel pas mngon par ngoms par byas so// de nas rim pas mkhar dga' nya mo sogs brgyud de rin spungs su phebs/ kha ru steng du sgar phab ste sde pa dang mjal/ dbon drung yab sras nang so thon pa/ byang pa drung 'tsho ba/ gnyer chen rnams la dbang rjes gnang mang du stsal lo// de dus 'bras yul skyed mos tshal nas dge bshes mang po mjal bar byon/ gsung chos kyi 'brel pas tshim par mdzad/ byams chen du phebs rten gsum rnams mjal/ slob dpon rnams kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun mang po la chos 'brel gyis yid dad pa'i sa la btsud do// de nas g.yung dar rgyas su mkhar rtse nas a che drung pas gdan drangs te/ dbang rjes gnang bzhed pa dang sbyar te gnang nas ra lung du phebs so// chu pho 'brug gi lo gsar mtshams 'gro mgon mthu stobs pa dang*/ phyag chen bkras rgyam pas mgo byas ri pa rnams la chos dbang gnang skabs/ rgyal rtse nas sde pa mngon dga' ba gnas mjal du phebs pa la/ gzhi lan phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas/ spos skya gzims khang du khyad 'phags mjal ba la byon te/

rang byon kha sarba ṇa phyag tu bzhes pa nas/ de nyid las sku bang du gser gyi char ba kun mthun grub tu babs so// de dus sde pa dpon g.yog gis gzhi byes rnams la mang ja 'gyed 'bul chas dang bcas pa mdzad do// de nas ri pa rnams mkha' la spyod pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor brdzangs nas/ dpon slob rnams dbus phyogs su phebs/ 'brug tu bka' yi bdud rtsi bar ma chad du stsol zhing stan chags pa na/ sde pa yang 'phyong gis nan gyis gsol ba'i mthus/ thog mar gzhis ka gong dkar du phebs te/ kun bzang pho brang du bzhugs/ dbon sa bdag mo'i drung la tshe rta dang*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rgyas pa gnang bar mdzad do// drung 'khor spyil zab chos kyi 'brel pa rgya chen pos (27 ba 54)dman pa'i lam rnams las bzlog bar bgyis so// phyir lam phebs dgos tshul gyi bka' nan du byung ba zhal gyis 'ches te/ rgyal chen gling du phebs/ klu khang du sgar mdzad de dam pa'i chos kyi rnga bo chos kyi rnga bo che kun tu bsgrags pas sa skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dge 'dun sgang nas mkhan chen rin chen bkra shis pas gtsos pa'i ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams kyi thugs mngon par tshim par mdzad do// de nas byams pa gling gi smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs te bzhugs pa na/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtse nas spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyas son te drag tu gsol ba btab pas phebs pa la zhugs sde pa ma chen dang sku mched drung rnams kyis bsam dgu'i 'dod yon bsod pa bsnams te/ gang la mchod cing nye bar 'dud pa'i phyir bsu bar phebs/ spe'u mkhar du mchod rten chen mo bzhengs pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad do// bde skyid gling du phebs shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor bar mdzad do// de nas pho brang 'ching bar stag rtser phebs/ mi dbang sras dang bcas pa la bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/

tshe rta dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gser las grub pa'i rab tu gnas pa nyin gnyis ma rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba gnang ba'i dngos gzhi'i nyin/ yongs su rdzogs par dbang po'i mtshon cha rab tu bkra bas kun gsal gyi khong rnams mdzes par brgyan/ 'od kyi phung po 'bar ba'i lha'i me tog gi char chen tshal cil du bab/ de yang*/ bsod nams kyi tshong zong chen pos thob pa'i nor can rnams ni rab tu dad pa skye bar bla zhing phyir bzlog par dka' la/ ltas rab tu dge ba'i rgyu shes pas dad pa cher 'phel bar gyur cing*/ log rtog gi nad kyis dge ba'i mig long bdag kyang gnas de la ngo mtshar du brtsi'o// de nas bsam bde ba'i spyan 'dren byung nas/ sde pa sgyu mched yum sras kyis gshegs skyel mdzad de phebs pa na/ nang so rdzong dpon pa dpon g.yog gis bsus nas/ lhun po sgang du phebs so// (28 na 55)sde pa ma chen gyis gtsos pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang*/ g.ya' bzang nas chos kyi rje spyan snga rin po che dang bcas par phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa/ ro snyoms sgang dril dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa mang dag gnang ngo*// byang chub sdings pa dpon slob mang 'dus la khrid lung gi rim pa du ma stsal bas dge ba'i myu gu gong du spel/ de dus tsan dan dkar dmar las grub pa'i sngags sku sogs rten mang du bzhengs pa la rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du mdzad pa na/ de'i nyin 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang kha dog bzang po'i me tog gi char chen pos sa kun khor mo yug tu khyab par byas pas nor 'dzin rje bo 'bangs dang bcas pa mi bskyud pa'i dang ba kun nas rgyas par gyur to/ de nas rim pas 'phyong rgyas brgyud nas/ yar rgyab tu thegs sde pa dpon chen pa'i drung gis bsu ba la phebs te dar lung du gdan chags par mdzad/ dpon sa phun tshogs bkra shis dbang gi rgyal mo dang*/ mi'i bdag po ngag dbang rin chen phun tshogs gnyis la phag mo'i byin rlabs sogs dbang rjes gnang*/

dgas bsdus la phyag chen/ chos drug /dbon rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ sa skyong ba'i dbang po dbon chen pa dang*/ sngags ston shākya dpal mgon dang*/ bla ma bya pa/ bla ma sa phug pa/ rab 'byams pa gsum rnams la/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo'i khrid dang khrigs ma zhal gdams nges pa can rnams gnang dus/ zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi ring tshang mar chos thun tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar la mdangs sna tshogs la rab tu bkra ba/ 'dab ma mang po'i 'od zer gyi phung po can bsung zhim po'i dad ldang ba lha'i gnas kyi me tog gi char nyi ma'i 'od zer 'grib pa tsam babs/ dam pa rnams kyi 'jig rten las brgal ba'i spyod pa ma smad pa 'di dag gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi stobs snang ba des so// de dus bya yul nas mi'i dbang phyug chen po bstan 'dzin nor bu rgyal (28 ba 56)sar bkod pa'i shis brjod la spyan 'dren cig car rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob shin tu mang bar 'byor te gsol ba'i ngor chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar zhal gyi 'ches so// nor 'dzin dbang po yum sras rnams kyis mkho dgu'i yo byad bzang po ji snyed pa phul nas rim pas 'phyong rgyas su phebs so// gong ma chen po'i rgyal srid kyi kha lo pa'i gtso bo rgyal srid chos bzhin du spyod pa'i lha rin chen rgyal mchog mes dbon de'i khri lcam don yod sgrol mas/ 'dzad pa med pa'i yo byad kyis mchod cing spyi sgos kyi gnas tshul 'bul ba dang bcas mdzad nas/ bsam bder mi dbang yab sras spyan snga rin po che dang bcas par chos kyi 'od zer khyab par spros te/ sde pa rdzong dpon pa'i drung gis gshegs skyel mdzad/ de nas rim pas gnyal gyi yul gru chen po'i ya gyal sho bo zhes pa'i nang du phebs pa na/ chos kyi rje bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba khu dpon blon 'bangs dang bcas pas mchod sprin chen pos bkur zhing bstod nas byon no// lam bar dag tu skye dgu rnams rang rang gi nus pa ji snyed pa'i mchod pas bkur sti dang ri mor byed bzhin pas pho brang yang rtser phebs pa'i tshe/

rab tu byung ba brgya stong gi tshogs kyis mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsti stang du byed cing bsus so// 'bum phrag tsam gyi 'khor gyis bskor cing mdun gyis bltas pa/ byang chub snying po'i spor srid pa tham pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs pa lta bu'i bkod pa'i khyad par chen po las khyad chen por gyur pa thams cad gcig tu spungs pa'i mdzes pas blta na chog mi shes par byas pa'i spyod yul gyi gtso bor byon// chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po nang la/ dpon slob rnams kyis gzhal du dben pa'i gnang sbyin bgrang ba las kyang ches bgrang du med pa dag stsal te/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas me tog mngon par 'thor ro// khri dpon chen po blon 'bangs rnams kyis rkyang rin po che'i tshogs dpag tu med pas gtsos pa'i mtha' yas pa'i 'bul ba gya nom pa mdzad do// de nas rje dam ngas (29 na 57)bshad sgrub kyi tshogs dang bcas pas zad mi shes pa'i 'byor pas bstabs te de dag tu rgyal ba'i bka'i bgro gleng dang*/ dkar brgyud gong ma'i mgur dbyangs dang bcas pas dgyes dgu'i longs spyod rgya chen po la spyad/ der rjes gsal rje sgrub sde pad+ma dkar por spyan drangs khyad 'phags kyi tshogs mang du bzhugs pa rnams mjal zhing sgom chen pa rnams la tshe dbang la sogs pa'i gsung gi dga' ston chen po bkye'o// de nas chos rgyal gling du phebs te sde pa khu dbon la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs kyi zab mo theg pa'i bka'i 'khor lo kun nas bskor bas yang dag pa'i nges pa la thugs mngon par bkri bar mdzad/ mchod yon ltan du rdo rje nag po phyag bzhi pa la mnga' gsol gyi gtor 'bul rgya chen pos mchod/ bris sku dang rten gsum mang por rab tu gnas pa gnang la/ ring zhig gdan chags par gsol kyang ma gnang bar rim gyis sa 'dzin dbang po khu dbon rnams dang thabs gcig par gnyal rgya rab ces pa'i phu'i bar phebs so// dpon slob rnams rim pas bsam bder byon te/

lha tsa ri dbang po rje blon dang bcas pas rab lo gsum/ 'bring lo gcig tha na'ang zla ba gnyis gsum gyi ring mchod pa'i yul dam par bzhugs zhes nan tur gyis gsol ba btab pas kyang zhal gyis ma 'tshes par/ rings stabs kyis 'phyong rgyas brgyud nas/ yar rgyab tu phebs so// dar lung*/ dpal 'byor rab brtan/ bkra shis rnam rgyal rnams su bzhugs/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi mdzod rten 'brel gyi skor la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo khor mo nyid du bskor bar mdzad pa'i tshe rgyal mkhar gling du gnas bcu'i rab gnas la phebs par gsol ba gnang ste dpal ldan sdom pa'i sgo nas tshul dang mthun pa'i rab tu gnas pa bgyis shing*/ de nas gdan sa phyogs su phebs pa la zhugs te/ rnam rgyal nas pho brang gong dkar brgyud gdan sa chen po 'brug tu phebs so// (29 ba 58)der 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i gdul thal gyi myang 'das mchod rten la ar+gha'i cho ga mdzad nas/ seng khri ma gtogs tshang mar zhig gsos bsgrubs te/ rab tu gnas pa'i nyin mo 'ja' 'od phan tshun du sbrel ba'i sna mchod rten la zug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyis 'dus pa rnams yid dang bar byas/ der sngags 'chang shākya dpal mgon pa dang*/ chos kyi mgon pa/ rab 'byams smra ba dpal rin pa dang*/ dharma pa/ rin chen rdo rje ba la sogs pa'i sgom chen du ma lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub pa snying por spyod pa la bzhag ste/ dpon slob rnams ra lung du phebs so// khri thog rin po che rnam pa gnyis la o rgyan gyi phreng skor la sogs pa'i zab chos rim pa bar ma chad du stsol zhing par ma rungs pa'i spyod tshul dag kyang thabs la mkhas pas rang zhir mdzad/ de nas ston gyi dur khri rin po che dpon slob bcu phrag bdun lhag pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pa lho'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i ched du rdzong dar mdzad do// rje nyid 'dus pa'i tshogs rgya chen po dang ldan pas dbus kyi rgyal khams su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/

mgar grong theg chen yongs 'du'i zhing khams su phebs/ gcung rin po che dpon slob rnams la mai tri lugs kyi bde mchog dang*/ phyag rdor gtum po lha mangs gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang bka' gtad dang bcas pa gnang*/ gsar 'dus kyi dge 'dun mang dag la phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos drug la sogs pa'i khrid lung stsol bzhin par 'brug tu phebs so// phag mo lhan cig skyes ma'i byin rlabs/ 'gro ba'i mgon po yab sras kyi thugs dam dge sbyor bdun pa'i khrid/ rgyal dbang rje'i bka' 'bum sogs mu med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mngon par bskor ro// de dus lho brag nas drung kun dga' lhun grub pa zhabs kyi pad+mar phyag bgyi bar byon/ (30 na 59)dpal rgyam pas mgo byas ba rje len 'khor ba rnams kyis 'bul ba'i tshogs mang du phul/ drung kun dga' bsam gtan pa'i dpon po drung du son te/ gtsug phud bzhi sing chos kyi gter mdzod ces gnang ngo*// de nas skyid shong phan tshun du zhabs kyis 'chag par mdzad de chos dang zang zing gi 'brel bas yul 'khor du gnas pa rnams la dge legs kyi dpal yon sbyin pa'i skabs shig tu/ thon nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po nad so don grub mgon po pa'i gdan 'dren par gsol ba'i ngor phebs te sdom pa bcu gsum/ gtum po lha mangs/ tshe rta la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas gnang*/ gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo/ phyag chen chos drug dge sbyor bdun pa rnams la khrid dus 'thon zhing so so'i ngo sprod/ rgyal dbang rje'i bka' 'bum dang bcas pa'i khrid lung mang dag khu dbon gnyis kyis gnang ngo*// der bris thang grub brgyad pa/ nyid kyi sku 'dra la/ mai tri lugs kyi rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa mdzad de slar smyug par phebs so// yab yum la phyag chen yi ge bzhi pas gtsos pa'i khrid lung dbang rjes gnad dang bcas pa mang dag gnang bar re zhig bzhugs/

de dus bkod po me rag mdo nas ri bskul bas sleb ste/ dbon po chos kyi gter mdzod pa sgrub sde'i bla mar bskos/ lo lnga las 'gyangs med kyi brje len du rdzong dar mdzad do// de nas chu bo ri brgyud ra lung du phebs/ mi bsrun pa skye bo dan pa ri bya ba/ 'dam bu'i tshal la glang po ces bya ba bzhin du thams la mkhas pas rmeg med par btul te bzhag go// blta na bzang po'i smon mthong bas nad las grol ba ltar/ dad pa dang*/ zhe sdang ba dang*/ chags pas gang la blta ba thams cad kyi gti mug dang 'dod chags sdang ba'i nad kyis gtsas pa las grol ba rang gyur ro// rang bya kha sarba ṇa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag bde chen po spos sbyar phebs/ rdor 'dzin gyi spo len dang*/ ri thes kyi rdzong der rus la phab ste/ (30 ba 60)khams pa chos mdzad chos rgyal mtshan pa gdan sar bkod/ 'gro mgon skya se ba dang bcas dpon slob phyed dang nyis brgya tsam tsa rir rdzong dang mdzad do// de'i dus phag mo'i byin rlabs/ rten 'brel rabs bdun ma/ zhang bka' 'bum dang bcas pa'i gsung gi gsang ba du ma gnang*/ bya yul nas chen po gling smad pas gtsos pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren par gsol ba'i mthus/ mtho ris kyi 'byor pa thams cad kyis khengs pa/ pho brang gong ri dkar por phebs/ lugs gnyis kyi bka' btags kyis sa chen po'i khyon las rgyal ba gyur pa'i che sa yab yum gyis dpon slob thams cad lnga zhabs tog rgya chen pos phud dud dang ri mor mdzad do// dbon sa bdag mo'i drung la mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang*/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa gnang zhing*/ de'i tshe yar klungs kyi phyogs su 'brum nad yod pa'i gtam gsan pa'i stobs kyis bya yul du phebs pa bshol te chen po 'phying rdzong dang mdzad/ dpon slob rnams 'brug tu phebs dus/ byang stag lud la phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba byung bas/

chibs byi kha lo bsgyur te lam bar gyi skye bo drag zhan rnams kyis mchod sprin chen po'i dbung du gshegs bzhin par/ lha sang jo shākya gi drung du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas yun du gnas pa'i smon lam dpag med mdzad/ de nas rim pas byon te nyid po kam pa nas stag lung pas bsus ba/ dwags lung nas dpyid la la byon no// stag lung thel du mkhan slob/ dpon chen dang bcas pa'i kling pa'i bsu ba kun tu bzang po'i sprin gyi phung pos mtshon pa'i dper 'os pa'i bkod pa'i khyad par gyis gtsug lag khang chen mor gdan drangs te/ khyams su dbon rin po che phyag 'bul la phebs/ mnyam phyag mdzad/ mchod khang steng du dga' ston chen po'i dpal 'dzad mi shes pa la dgyes dgur spyad do// bzhugs yul 'jag spyil rin po che dang (31 na 61)yang dgon sbrel mar gnang ste/ gzhi pa dpon slob rnams la 'bul 'gyed rgya chen po gnang zhing*/ de nas shin tu mi ring bar skye ba dang skye bar sbyangs pa'i stobs sad pa'i yon tan tshad med pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje dpon rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis grags pa dpal bzang po'i drung la thog ma'i bka' 'brel du brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bla ma'i rnal 'byor shin tu rgyas pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa stsal lo// de nas bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon chos rje'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ pha rin po che'i chos drug sogs nyams khrid du bskyang bar mdzad/ stag lung thang pa chen po nas kun mkhyen ngag dbang grags pa'i bar gyi bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa/ dwags po bka' 'bum/ phag mo brda bzhi'i dbang*/ sha ba ra'i phag mo lhan cig skyes ma'i byin rlabs/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i lugs phyag na rdo rje lha nyer lnga ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ rgyal dbang bka' 'bum dang bcas pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa mang pos thugs kyi bzhed pa gang bar byas so// mchod khang steng nas 'bul chen bgrang bar yas pas mchod/

gzhan ma rnams kyis rang rang gi mthu stobs ji snyed pa'i 'bul ba'i tshogs phul lo// phyir phebs lam rnams su yang mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pas mchod par bgyis shing*/ de nas lhun grub rdzong skyes tshul du bzhugs sgar phab/ nang so yab yum dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad nas zab don chos 'khor du phebs/ 'dus pa rnams la gsung chos kyi 'khor lo ris med pa na bskor bzhin du mkhar rtsegs grub rgyal/ lhun po rtse rnams kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog yang dag pa zhus te/ bka' dbang phran tshegs kyang gnang bar mdzad do// de dus 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod chen po blo mos rgyal du snying po'i brtan pa dar zhang rgyal pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad pa'i tshe/ g.yar lam du shar gyi phyogs nas 'od zer tshad med pa 'phro ba nyin (31 ba 62)mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun shar bas sa chen po'i khyon ma lus par gsal bar byas shing*/ pad+mo'i tshogs rnams rab tu rgyas par gyur to/ de ni gang gi 'phrin las kyi ba dan bsgreng ba'i skyes bu ji ltar 'byon gyi snga ltas su nges/ de dus brag dkar dbon sa chos mdzad mas/ gyer re mar 'phrang du gzhi len dang 'bul ba gtos shin tu che bas mchod par mdzad/ de nas lha sar phebs te jo bo rin po che la gser chab gsol bar mdzad nas/ gdan sa 'brug tu phebs/ 'dus pa'i sde du ma la khrid chen brgyad dang*/ rten 'brel chig chog ma la sogs pa'i khrid gnang bar mdzad do// der lho sgrub sde'i bla mar rdor 'dzin kun spangs pa bsko gzhag mdzad nas/ chos lung smar mus thon du phebs/ lam bar gyi sde dbon rigs rnams kyis zhabs tog rgya chen pos mchod/ de nas lho brje len pa dge 'dun brgya nyi shu tsam bzang rags rdzong dar mdzad la/ de dus kong po nas bla ma chos kyi gter mdzod dpon slob kyang byon/ nang so don grub mgon po pa la phag mo'i byin brlabs/

tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang*/ rten 'brel rab bdun ma/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i khyad chos bsre bskor gsum rnams kyi khrid thon gzhis ka bsam 'grub mthong smon du stsal/ de nas sgrub sde gsar btab zab don dar rgyas su phebs/ shis brjod kyi rab tu gnas pa gnang*/ lhan skyes kyi dbang*/ mgon po'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa/ dpon rin po che mchod yon gnyis/ bla ma chos rgyal dpal bzang ba dang bcas par/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen nas brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i khrid/ nang so dang*/ bla ma do 'o ri par thub pa lnga/ do 'o ri pa la sger du dkor mdzad le'u drug pa'i khrid/ nang so la bla ma sgrub pa'i lung khrid zhal gdams/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ mgon po'i lha khrid 'khor lo bzhi ma rnams gnang nas/ rim pas smyug lar phebs so// bla ma chos rgyal dpal bzang thon (32 na 63)sgrub sde'i bla mar bskos/ smyug lar nang so yab yum rnams la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dbang*/ tshe rta/ ro snyoms phyag rgya chen por sgang du dril ba khrid du gnang ngo*// bla ma chos kyi gter mdzod la rten 'brel rab bdun ma dang bcas pa'i khrid 'ga' shas gnang*/ de nas gong dkar du phebs/ re zhig bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang phyir phebs par zhal gyis bzhes te/ yar rgyab rgyal chen gling gi rab gnas la gdan drangs par phebs so// nang so dpon chen pas sku'i mdun bsus te dpon slob nyung btus zhig gzhis ka nang du gdan chags par mdzad do// dge 'dun phal mo che phyi ru sgar phab ste gza' tshes 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ sa brtag bslang sbyang ba sta gon dang dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa zhag shas gnang*/ gser 'phyang gi lo cho 'phrul chen po'i dus bzang po gsum pa la rab gnas kyi sta gon dang*/ rgyal ba gsum pa la dngos gzhi mdzad do// de dus nam mkha' rab tu dngas pa la me tog gi char bab pa nor 'dzin gyi 'dzan pho dang 'dzan mo dag gi kun dga' rtsed 'jo'i dpyid sna tshogs las lha'i dga' tshal bzhin du blta bas mi ngoms par byas so// der sde pa yum sras drung la rten 'brel chig chog ma'i khrid/

nang so sku gzhon pa la rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa dang cog sgar gyi dge 'dun rnams la lam zab bla ma sgrub pa/ rten 'brel gsil lu mar rgyas bshad dang bcas pa gnang*/ de nas dpon sa bdag mo'i drung gi gdan 'dren pas son te/ 'bul ba'i rnam grangs ches bzang pos mchod par byas nas/ rim gyis pho brang gong ri dkar por phebs so// spel chen gyi dga' ldan du gzims chung mdzad/ der mkhas pa chen po rje btsun mi'i mchog gi gsung ngag ro snyoms chen mo'i khrid dang*/ gzhan dbang rjes gnang mang du gnang ngo*// drung 'khor drag zhan gyi re ba chos kyi sbyin pas gang bar mdzad/ bla ma chos kyi gter mdzod dang*/ (32 ba 64)bla ma brgya byin pa'i skye ba bsam gtan gter mdzod pa gnyis lhan cig tu kong por rdzong dar mdzad/ lha khang dpon po pa sogs lho brag gi bstan pa'i 'dzin bkod la rdzong dar gnang ste/ 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams la bka' 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad do// chos yab yum gyis gya nom pa'i 'bul ba mdzad de/ slar 'phyong rgyas su gdan drangs/ sde pa yab yum rnams la rten 'brel rabs bdun ma dang*/ tshe rta lam zab bla ma sgrub pa/ phyag chen dang bcas pa'i khrid/ 'phags sde pa rnams la yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid rnams gnang*/ rim pas bde skyid gling du phebs gtum po khyung lnga'i byin rlabs mdzad/ rim gyis gdan sa 'brug tu phebs te/ mi ring bar bdag kyang zhabs phyir son no// byang chub chen po'i drung du skra bcad/ nā ro ta pa'i rgyal tshab 'gyur med ngag dbang nor bu'i sde zhes ming dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang*/ de nas sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ gtum po khyung lnga'i byin rlabs/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang shin tu rgyas pa/ tshe rta/ khrid chen brgyad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi gnad rten 'brel rab bdun gyi khrid dang*/ lung*/ mnga' bdag mar pa/

chos rje gtsang pa/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// gzhan dkar brgyud bka' 'bum rnams dbon rin po che'i drung gis stsal lo// skabs de'i tshe rdo rje 'dzin po'i dbon po chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa dang rgyal dbang pa sogs phyogs mtha'i bu slob mang du 'dus pa rnams kyang gsung gi bdud rtsis 'khor ba'i gdung ba nye bar zhi bar mdzad do// de nas mgar grong theg chen yongs 'dur phebs ro snyoms rnam rtog lam khyer gyi khrid du bya ba tsam gnang*/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i dngul sku zhig kyang sgrub par mdzad de/ nged rnams bya yul du phyir rdzong ba gnang ngo*// de nas byang stag lung nas gdan 'dren pas sleb/ lus can rnams (33 na 65)kyi bde skyid skye ba'i ched du rim pas phebs/ stag lung thang du gdan chags pa'i ngos dbon rin po che sku mched gnyis la bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yab bka' yum bka'/ gtum po khyung lnga ma/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe rta/ rgyal dbang rje'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ bla sgrub/ ro snyoms/ rten 'brel gyi khrid/ phyag chen skor gsum zhang bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i lung*/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyis gtsos pa'i po ta dbang dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// de yang*/ chos kyi sgo thas cad la dbang 'byor pa'i bla ma skal ba chen po'i khyad par gyis brgyan pa'i slob ma la/ chos 'di'i bdag po gyis shig pa nyid mchog yin gyi/ gzhan dag gis yun ring du dal bas bklags pa ni/ ci yang mi byed pa rnams las lhag pa tsam mo// der gzhi byed kyi tshogs pa sum stong tsam la dgas po'i chos bzhi/ lam zab mos gus kyi khrid la srogs pa gnang*/ zhal thang gtos che ba la rab tu gnas pa stsal/ chos rje rin po che sku mched kyis 'bul ba shin tu gya nom pa dang*/ gzhan yang zang zing gi longs spyod ni char ltar du babs shing*/

de dus dbon rin po che mched kyis ya thang gi bar du gshegs skyel la phebs/ thugs yid gcig tu gyur pa'i stobs kyis 'bral bar mi phod pa'i gdung bas yun ring du 'da' bar gyur to/ dpon slob rnams rim pas phebs tshe/ yab pa gdan sa pa dpon slob kyis gdan drangs/ bka' chos kyi 'brel bas yid mgu ba bskyed par mdzad nas 'brug tu phebs/ de dus khri rin po che sku khams bsnyung ba la brten/ gcung rin po che dpon slob ra lung du rdzong ba gnang*/ dkar po'i phyogs rgyas par byed pa'i thabs sna tshogs pa bgyis mod kyi/ de lta na'ang*/ gdul bya'i skal bas ring po ram lon par zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi gral dbur phebs/ (33 ba 66)der nang rten gser zangs las grub pa'i lha babs mchod rten thog tshad ma phra yang rin thang can gyi rin po che 'ba' zhig gis byas pa dang*/ rgyal dbang rje'i sku tshad ma shin tu byon gtsang ba bzhengs/ yon rdzongs shin tu che ba stsal/ bde mchog gi rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa gnang ngo*// de dus rje nyid kyi zhal slob 'bar ra don grub sdings kyi gdan sa ba smyug la rab 'byams pa dpon slob sum brgya lhag pa mjal bar byon/ gzhan yang gtsang nyang rong*/ 'brog /lho mon rnams nas skye bo khri phag mang pos mjal bar sleb/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i dgra bor gang gi sku mthong ba dang gsung gi bdud rtsi myong pa dang*/ reg pa nyid gyur to/ de dus lho brag nas bla ma rgyal dbang pa dang*/ kong po sgrub sde nas dge slong dbang bzang po grogs mched/ lho byang sgrub sde nas shākya don grub dang legs pa rgya mtsho sogs 'dzom pa'i/ sgar sgrub sde khyon gcig tu bsre ba'i bka' bgros kyi gzhi bting*/ gsar bu thams cad sgar du brten pa'i chos thob gang che dang bstun sgrub sde so sor rdzong dar byed pa'i dam bca'/ brje len kyang brang sprod ma yin pa'i bsgor mo byed par thag bcad de sgrub sde'i mi sna rnams kyis the'u rtse dang*/

bden dbang gi bka' shog kyang 'byor ba byas te rdzong dar so sor byas so// rgyal ba'i bdag po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gsung ngag tshig nyung bas chos kyi sgo mo thams cad ston par nus pa/ de kho na nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig re res skal ldan gyi gdul bya grol bar mdzad pa las/ yi ger 'khod pa dag ni/ gsung mgur/ bstod tshogs/ 'phrin yig /dris lan/ sgrub pa zhal bkod/ tshogs chos/ bde mchog gi sgrub dkyil/ sbyin sreg rab gnas la sogs pa'i phyag len gyi skor/ phyag chen chos drug /bla sgrub/ rten 'brel sogs zab khrid/ mdo lung rin chen spungs pa la sogs pa bka' po tā gsum tsam bzhugs (34 na 67)pa/ 'phral mar go bla zhing*/ gser bzang po ltar brtags shing dpyad na/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gting mkhas pa'i dbang po dbyig gi rtsa lag gis kyang rtogs par mi nus pa/ legs par bshad pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas dam pa'i gter bzhin du bzhugs so// de yang*/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku'i ring la/ gdan sa rin po che rnams dar zhing rgyas pa bgrang ba las 'das pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon chen por mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ rnal 'byor rtogs ldan la sogs pa'i slob bus khyab par byas pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor mdzad do// de nas yid du 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis ljon shing rnams dud cing mdzes par byas pa'i tshe/ nged 'bod par bla ma bya pa/ dbu mdzad thugs rje pa dang kun khyab pas mgo byas/ dge 'dun bdun cu lhag tsam gnang ste/ mi 'gyang bar zhabs kyi pad mor son no// de dus phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ thugs dam dge sbyor bdun pa/ lam zab bla ma sgrub pa tshe khrid dang bcas pa nyan no// de'i tshe lho sgrub sder dge 'dun brgya phrag gcig lhag tsam rdzong dar bgyis te rje dbon gcung rin po che dbus phyogs su chibs kha bskyod par gyur pa'i skabs/

rje'i zhal nas/ nged nyi shu dgu'i zla ba yin dus/ da sgos ba na pa'i 'dzin skyong gi khur kun khyed la bab pa yin pas/ tshul 'di lta bu gyis zhes pa'i bka' bkod nan chags su mdzad do// gzhan yang spyi sgos kyi bka' stsal zhib thems kyi rjes su/ dgos dus lhug par smra na zab pa yin/ kha chems dal dus 'jog pa brling ba yin/ zhes yang yang du gsung ba dang*/ gsol dpon nam mkha' dang*/ gzims tshe ba sogs sku'i nye logs su gnas pa dag la/ khyed rnams kyang kho bo'i 'tsho rtsis yun ring por byed mi dgos par 'dug /ces zhing 'di'i mdzad pa mthar son pa'i gsung ngag kyang mang du phebs/ de nas lo gsar 'phral/ mkha' (34 ba 68)la spyod pa'i gnas mchog cig car gyi rdor 'dzin du dmar ḍā ki ras chen bsko gzhag gnang ste/ 'gro mgon ri thebs dang bcas dge 'dun brgya zin tsam rdzong dar mdzad do// hor zla dang po'i nyer bzhi la/ chos byed spyi'i dran pa'i gsal 'debs su byas pa'i zhal gdams dang*/ bka' shog zhib 'thems dbus phyogs su thebs/ nged rnams la rten 'brel/ ro snyoms/ lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i zhal gdams bka' rgya ma rnams nyer brgyad tshun la rdzogs par gnang ngo*// de yang*/ bzhed srid mtha'i bar du sku'i snang ba gcig gis 'da' bar nus mod kyi/ 'dod sred kyis kun tu gcos pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ rdo rje'i sku de lta bu 'jig na/ bdag cag chu'i lbu ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i lus kun lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes yid byung bas nges par 'byung ba'i lam la zhugs te/ sdug bsngal tha mar byed pa'i dbang dang mthu 'di gzigs nas/ dgung lo bdun cu don drug bzhes pa kun ldan zhes pa/ lcags pho byi ba lo'i dgun zla tha chung*/ mchus nya pa hor zla dang por grags pa'i nyer bdun mtshan mo thun gyi 'go rtsom par mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe/ nyams pa'i skye bo'i grib kyis gos pa'i tshul bstan no// de la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal bsgrag pa dang*/

bsrung ma'i bskang gso brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i nag po'i phyogs pham par byed pa'i thabs sna tshogs pa bgyis kyang snyun las grol ba'i tshul ma gyur to/ de yang*/ rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung chen pos bskyod cing rgyu skar 'khrug pa dang*/ skar mda' ltung ba la sogs pa mi dge ba'i bltas rab tu mang ba byung ngo*// de nas kho bo cag la spyan sngar la gor shog ces pa'i bka' thod du nos te/ zhabs la phyag bgyis pa'i tha mar son no// bstan pa 'dzin skyong rgyas par 'gyur ba'i smon lam kyang gnang ste/ mang po labs kyang lhag ma lus pa las med/ da gdan myur du drongs shig ces bka' stsal ba'i ma nus/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta ba dang*/ lus ngag zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud pa'i phyi mar (35 na 69)bgyis te song ngo*// de nas gnam gang gi nyin mo de nyid thun gsum pa'i skabs la mngon par babs pa na/ thabs kyis sgrol ba'i sku mkha' khyab kyi zhing du bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa las/ de ma thag 'dzam bu'i gling chen po ri dbang dbang bcas pa mngon par g.yos par gyur to/ 'dod pa rigs drug pa'i lha'i gnas bzhi pa rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po kun tu phab/ tshangs ris la sogs pa 'og min du thug pa'i bar gyi lha rnams kyis kyang*/ mchod pa'i ched du sku'i gdung ga la bar dmigs te/ snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs pa bsgrag pa dang*/ dri bzang po'i bsung 'byin pa dang*/ sna lnga pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba gdugs phub pa lta bu'i me tog mang po rab tu 'thor bar byed do// phyogs kun tu 'tshub ma'i tshul bsangs par gyur nas/ rab tu dngas pa'i kun gsal la/ mkha' yi glang po bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan du ma'i gzugs la ras bal rgyud kyis mdzes par byas pa dang*/ 'ja'i gur rim brtsegs su phub pa la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyis dgongs pa rdzogs thabs yongs su rdzogs pa ma grub kyi bar du bstan no// re zhig gsang ba'i tshul brtsams kyang rmad du byung ba'i rtags mtha' yas pa mthong bas 'gro ba kun gyis shes te yid byung bar gyur/

de nas rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur ba thob pa'i dbon rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug nyid kyis gang la bya ba byas pas rgyal ba thams cad la byas par 'gyur ba'i khur bzhes te bka' phebs pa ltar/ nged cig 'gas zla ba gnyis pa'i dga' ba dang po nas brtsams te dkar po'i mthar thug gi bar la/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs brgya/ sbyin sreg brgya rtsa/ mchod pa'i bye brag gzhal du med pas sku yi gdung mnyes par byas so// 'dus pa'i tshogs brgya phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam gyis/ dpal sdom pa/ rdo rje gtum po/ nag po phyag bzhi pa la sogs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du (35 ba 70)zla ba gcig gi bar du mchod cing bstod do// de nas phyogs mtha'i dbu che phal mo che 'dus te/ dge 'dun nyis stong lhag tsam tshogs nas zla ba bzhi pa'i dga' ba dang po'i nyin 'bul 'gyed rnam gzhag dang bcas pas dgongs rdzogs kyi 'dun thabs legs par bsgrubs/ de nas dpal 'khor lo bde chen dang*/ rong byams chen rnams su 'gyed la sogs pa'i dgongs rdzogs byas so// nang rten nyid kyi sku tshad ma gser zangs las bal po'i rig byed zung gis bsgrubs shing*/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bris thang che ba gcig kyang bzhengs/ de nas dpal mgon gdan sa thel/ byang stag lung*/ na lan+da gnam rtse lding rnams su la dgongs pa rdzogs phyir 'gyed la sogs pas dge 'dun gyi tshogs mnyes par bgyis so// der rje'i phyi rten sgrub par bzhed nas/ dge byed de chu pho stag gi lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu nas 'go brtsams te/ bal po dpon mo tsha ba lu gu sing dang*/ a ba la sring gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rig byed pa bcu gnyis kyis/ sku rgyu zangs khal sum brgya dang gnyis/ gser zho dgu brgya dang nyi shu/ dngul chu brgya phrag lnga bcu rtsa lnga lhag pa'i nyi shu'i grangs las grub par byas pa'i rin po che'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang rkyang khu bco lnga'i dpangs dang ldan pa/

de'i bre'i nang du rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku gser zho bcu phrag bzhi las grub pa/ bum nang la gser zho sum brgya las grub pa'i rje nyid kyi sku/ bang rim la dngul spo re bdun brgya dang nyer dgu/ li spo re lnga brgya dang sum cu las grub pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs bsrung ma dang bcas pa'i sku rnams dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dag gis legs par spras pa'i mchod spong dam pa de nyid yos lo zla ba bdun pa'i nang du rdzogs par grub par bgyis so// de yang*/ sku gdung rin po che dar zab kyis spras pa snying por bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi rim pas gtsos (36 na 71)pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' phal mo che la sogs pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyi rten ches bzang ba dag kyang mang du bzhugs su gsol/ bzo ba'i tshogs la'ang 'dzugs ston la sogs pa kun la bgrang ba las ches 'das pa'i longs spyod dang*/ gser zho nyis brgya gtsos pa'i zang zing dngos pos yid dga' mgu rangs sar byas so// de nas mdzes byed kyi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i nyer lnga la sa chog nas gzung ste dpal ldan sdom pa la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa khrums stod kyi rdzogs pa dang po yan la/ nged dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun bdun brgya tsam gyis grub par byas so// rgya mtsho dga' dang dbyig gi khu ba 'od yangs tsha bo gom gsum gnon pa gzhan snyems bzod/ mi bzad mtshon cha sna tshogs sgrub byed gangs ri'i bu mo'i bdag po'i dpal dang gzi brjid rnams/ gang gi gan du mog mog por gyur kun gyis phyag byas bstod pa'i sdig med bla ma ni/ dpal ldan bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i phung po kun tu bsngags par 'os/ lhas rtsen pha mtha' rnams 'dul skyes kyi rgyal po'i bgrod pas mngon pa dang*/ dbyig 'dzin rdul phran re re bskal brgyar dbrog pas zad 'di bya dka' min/

shes rab kun dang ngag gi lha mo'i mkhyen pas srid par gzhal byas kyang*/ yon tan gting mtha' dpog par mi nus bdag 'dra'i spyod yul ga la yin/ de lta na'ang dad pa'i gzhi la brtan zug pa'i/ rnam thar legs byas ldan pa'i 'khri shing che/ byu ru'i lcug phran gser zangs snye mas ni/ lcid pa rlung bzhon gyis bskyod ltar mdzes so// de lta'i dge ba ku mu ta dang pad dkar gsar ba'i 'dab ma dang*/ zla ba nya ba lta bur dri med gsal ba'i 'od chags 'di yis ni/ las kyi rlung ldan sdug bsngal me lces gdungs pa thams cad bsal byas te/ 'gyur ba nyams pa'i bde ba chen pos yid la sim pa ster bar byed gyur cig /rgya mtsho'i ska rags can 'di nyid/ dus mtha'i rlung gis ma gtor ba// (36 ba 72)da srid dam pa'i rnam thar 'di/ gnas pas legs byas kun byed shog /de ltar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jig rten gsum na 'gran pa'i zla med pa'i rgyal ba chen po gang gi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar 'od brgya pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal tshab rje btsun dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po'i bka' gnang ba gtsug tu bkur zhing spyan sngar zhus shing dag par byas pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi mgon po dang*/ chos rdzong mkhan po bsam gtan dbang phyug /sgom sde 'gro mgon bla ma rgya mtsho la sogs pa rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i dor/ dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ gdan sa chen po me tog mdangs 'phrog gi ljongs/ dpal ra lung thel gyi ri bo chen po gru 'dzin gyi spo/ spos kyi dad ldan pa'i zhing khams/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs pa'i gan+dho la'i nye logs/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa yid smon pa'i rtse mor/ zhib zhes pa sa mo bya'i lo khrums stod can gyi dkar po'i che'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la grub par bgyis pa'i/ yi ge pa ni yar stod pa lhun grub rdo rjes so/// /maṅga laṃ/
chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po na// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no//
